### Reports and Printed Forms

- [Reports and Printed Forms](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/) (ar: التقارير والنماذج المطبوعة): Reports are how you get your data back out of Nama ERP, and printed forms are how a single document reaches paper.
- [Jasper Reports Complete Guide for Nama ERP](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/reports-guide.html) (ar: دليل Jasper Reports الشامل لنظام Nama ERP): Every report and every printed form that Nama ERP produces is a JasperReports design: a layout file with a SQL query behind it and a set of prompts in front of it. - entities: ReportDefinition - screens (ar): تعريف تقرير - menu: Administration → Reports → Report Definition
- [Report and Form Wizards](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/report-and-form-wizards.html) (ar: أداتا إنشاء التقارير ونماذج الطباعة): Nama has two wizards. - entities: ReportWizard, PrintingFormWizard - screens (ar): أداة إنشاء تقرير, أداة إنشاء نموذج طباعة
- [Report Wizard Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/report-wizard-guide.html) (ar: دليل أداة إنشاء التقارير (Report Wizard)): Nama ERP provides an easy and effective way to create professional reports quickly using the Report Wizard tool. - entities: ReportWizard - screens (ar): أداة إنشاء تقرير - menu: Administration → Reports → Report Wizard
- [Data Sources](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/report-data-sources.html) (ar: مصادر البيانات (Data Source)): The Data Source screen: a saved query that a Report Wizard or Printing Form Wizard attaches to read data from another table, its Main, Conditions and Security Constraints tabs, and its parameters. - entities: DataSource - screens (ar): مصدر بيانات - menu: Administration → Reports → Data Source
- [Printing Form Wizard](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/printing-form-wizard-guide.html) (ar: أداة إنشاء نماذج الطباعة (Printing Form Wizard)): The Printing Form Wizard: building a printable form such as a sales invoice from lists of header and grid fields, how saving builds the form, sorting, page setup, and choosing when a form is used. - entities: PrintingFormWizard - screens (ar): أداة إنشاء نموذج طباعة - menu: Administration → Reports → Printing Form Wizard
- [Which Printed Form Comes Out](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/printed-form-selection.html) (ar: أي نموذج طباعة سيخرج): Press Print on a sales invoice and nothing is asked of you. - entities: ReportDefinition - screens (ar): تعريف تقرير - menu: Administration → Reports → Report Definition
- [Report Styles](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/report-styles.html) (ar: تنسيقات التقارير (Report Styles)): Building a report or a printed form with a wizard means placing dozens of fields, and every one of them needs a colour, a font, an alignment and a border. - entities: ReportStyle - menu: Administration → Reports → Report Style
- [Custom Report Menu](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/custom-report-menu.html) (ar: قائمة تقارير مخصصة (Custom Report Menu)): The Custom Report Menu screen: adding entries to a screen's More menu that open a report with parameters filled from the current record or list, ordering them, who sees them, and why one does not show. - entities: CustomReportMenu - menu: Administration → Reports → Custom Report Menu
- [NamaRep Expression Reference](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/reports-namarep-reference.html) (ar: مرجع تعبيرات NamaRep): Inside a report, anywhere JasperReports accepts an expression — a text field, a variable, a parameter default, a print-when condition — you can call NamaRep. - entities: ReportDefinition - screens (ar): تعريف تقرير
- [Querying Nama Tables with SQL](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/reports/querying-nama-tables.html) (ar: الاستعلام من جداول نما بلغة SQL): This page collects the rules every SQL query against a Nama ERP database has to follow — whether it feeds a report, a BI widget, a Virtual Entity, an approval condition or a quick check during a support call.

### Business Intelligence

- [Business Intelligence](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/bi/) (ar: ذكاء الأعمال (BI)): The BI module turns your live ERP data into interactive dashboards — charts, gauges, tables, and cards that talk to each other through cross-filters, drill-downs, and direct links.
- [BI Module — Dashboards & Analytics](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/bi/bi-module-guide.html) (ar: وحدة BI — لوحات المعلومات والتحليلات (BI Module — Dashboards & Analytics)): Nama ERP's BI module lets you build interactive dashboards that turn your live ERP data into charts, gauges, tables, and more. - entities: DashBoardWidget, DashBoard, DashBoardGroup, BICrossFilter, DashBoardWidgetWizard, BIPeriodComparisonConfig - screens (ar): عنصر اللوحة, لوحة, مجموعة  لوحات, فلتر تفاعلي للوحات, أداة إنشاء عنصر لوحة, إعدادات مقارنة الفترات
- [Nama ERP BI Module — Technical Reference](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/bi/bi-module-technical-reference.html) (ar: وحدة BI في Nama ERP — المرجع التقني): This document is the authoritative technical reference for the Nama ERP BI (Business Intelligence) module's JSON structures. - entities: DashBoardWidget, BICrossFilter, DashBoard, DashBoardWidgetWizard - screens (ar): عنصر اللوحة, فلتر تفاعلي للوحات, لوحة, أداة إنشاء عنصر لوحة
- [BI Reference — EnhancedMetricsCard (and legacy MetricsCards)](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/bi/bi-reference-enhanced-metrics-card.html) (ar: مرجع BI — EnhancedMetricsCard (وwidget المقاييس القديم MetricsCards)): Companion to bi-module-technical-reference.md. - entities: DashBoardWidget - screens (ar): عنصر اللوحة - menu: Administration → DashBoards → DashBoard Widget
- [BI Reference — EnhancedTable](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/bi/bi-reference-enhanced-table.html) (ar: مرجع BI — EnhancedTable): Companion to bi-module-technical-reference.md. - entities: DashBoardWidget - screens (ar): عنصر اللوحة - menu: Administration → DashBoards → DashBoard Widget
- [BI Reference — Wizard Mode](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/bi/bi-reference-wizard-mode.html) (ar: مرجع BI — وضع المعالج (Wizard Mode)): Companion to bi-module-technical-reference.md. - entities: DashBoardWidgetWizard, DashBoardWidget - screens (ar): أداة إنشاء عنصر لوحة, عنصر اللوحة

### Notifications

- [Notifications](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/notifications/) (ar: التنبيهات): Landing page for notifications: notification definitions, SMS and WhatsApp, Telegram, general announcements, bulk messages and internal chat.
- [Notification Definitions](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/notifications/notifications-system.html) (ar: تعريفات التنبيهات): A Notification Definition is one record that answers four questions about one message: what happens, on which records, who hears about it, and what they read. - entities: NotificationDefinition - screens (ar): تعريف تنبيهات - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Notification Definition
- [SMS and WhatsApp Configuration in Nama ERP](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/notifications/sms-and-whatsapp.html) (ar: إعداد الرسائل القصيرة (SMS) و WhatsApp في نظام نما ERP): Nama ERP supports sending messages via SMS and WhatsApp to users, customers, suppliers, and other entities. - entities: WhatsAppMessageConfiguration, WhatsAppMessage
- [Telegram Notifications in Nama ERP](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/notifications/telegram.html) (ar: التنبيهات عبر تليجرام (Telegram) في نظام نما): Nama can send invoices, approval requests, order confirmations and any other notification straight into a customer's or employee's Telegram chat, right beside the SMS and WhatsApp channels you already know. - entities: TelegramBotConfiguration, TelegramMessage, TelegramBotInfo - menu: Administration → Other → Telegram Bot Configuration
- [Frequently Asked Questions: Notifications and Messages](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/notifications/notification-fq.html) (ar: أسئلة شائعة عن التنبيهات والرسائل): When posting a receipt that contains multiple lines for multiple customers, you may notice that the notification is sent only to the first customer and not to the remaining customers in the other lines. - entities: NotificationDefinition - screens (ar): تعريف تنبيهات - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Notification Definition
- [General Announcements](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/notifications/general-announcements.html) (ar: الإعلانات العامة (General Announcements)): The General Announcement screen: time-limited Arabic and English announcements for all users or chosen users, groups and security profiles, where readers see them, formatting, and why one is not showing. - entities: GeneralAnnouncement - screens (ar): إعلانات عامة - menu: Administration → Other → General Announcement
- [Bulk Messages, WhatsApp Messages and Internal Chat](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/notifications/bulk-messages-whatsapp-and-chat.html) (ar: الرسائل المجمعة ورسائل واتساب والمحادثات الداخلية): Most messages in Nama are sent by a Notification Definition: something happens to a record, and the definition decides who hears about it and through which channel. - entities: BulkMessage, WhatsAppMessage, WhatsAppMessageConfiguration, ErrorMessage - screens (ar): رسالة مجمعة, رسالة خطأ

### Field Filtering

- [Field Filtering](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/field-filtering/) (ar: فلترة الحقول): When a reference field offers the wrong records — too many, too few, or the wrong branch's — one of three tools is behind it, and they are easy to confuse because two of them sit next to each other in the menu with almost the same name.
- [Field Filtering by Dimension](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/field-filtering/field-filtering-by-dimension.html) (ar: فلترة الحقول بالمحددات (Field Filtering)): The Field Filtering screen: loosening the dimension narrowing of one reference field's lookup, such as offering every branch's warehouses on a stock transfer, with the Prevent Filter By and Ignore Login switches. - entities: FieldFiltering - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Field Filtering
- [Field Filter with Criteria](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/field-filtering/field-filter-with-criteria.html) (ar: فلتر الحقل بالمعايير (Field Filter with Criteria)): You can use the Field Filter with Criteria screen to apply custom filters when searching within specific fields on any Nama ERP screen. - entities: UserFieldFilter - screens (ar): فلترة حقل بمعايير - menu: Administration → Display Customization → Field Filter With Criteria
- [Modifying Translations](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/translations.html) (ar: تعديل الترجمات): How to change Arabic and English labels of screens, fields and actions with a Translation OverRider record, edit them from the screen with Alt + Ctrl + T, and use the Export Translations window. - entities: TranslationOverRider - screens (ar): تغيير ترجمة - menu: Basic → Settings → Translation OverRider

### Background Processing

- [Background Processing](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/background-processing/) (ar: المعالجة في الخلفية): Landing page for the background queues: business requests, pending tasks, system actions, report monitoring and task queues, and which screen to check for a given complaint.
- [Business Requests](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/background-processing/business-requests.html) (ar: طلبات الأعمال (Business Requests)): The Business Requests screen: the accounting and inventory requests raised when a document is saved, reading the Processing Status, finding what went wrong, what to do about it, and Saved Business Requests. - menu: Administration → Settings → Business Requests
- [Pending Tasks](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/background-processing/pending-tasks.html) (ar: المهام المعلقة (Pending Tasks)): The Pending Tasks screen, the outbox for email, SMS, WhatsApp and mobile push messages: what queues them, reading status, trials and errors, what to do about a failure, and when nothing is sent at all. - menu: Administration → Settings → Pending Tasks
- [System Actions](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/background-processing/system-actions.html) (ar: إجراءات النظام (System Actions)): The Pending System Action queue of background work, such as salary document regeneration and outgoing HTTP calls, and the Auto System Action journal of what the system already did.
- [Report Monitoring](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/background-processing/report-monitoring.html) (ar: متابعة التقارير (Reports Monitoring)): A report that takes thirty seconds and a report that has hung look identical from the outside — a spinner, and a user asking whether to keep waiting. - menu: Reports → Reports Monitoring
- [Task Queues](https://docs.namasoft.com/platform/background-processing/task-queues.html) (ar: طوابير المهام (Task Queues)): The Task Queue screen: running scheduled tasks and entity flows in parallel lanes instead of one single line, putting tasks and flows on a queue, the rules that keep queues safe, and watching them work. - entities: TaskQueue, EntityFlow, TaskSchedule - screens (ar): طابور المهام, مسار الكيان, مهمة مجدولة - menu: Basic → Settings → Task Queue

## Modules

- [Modules](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/) (ar: الوحدات): Landing page of the module guides: links to every Nama ERP module, from accounting, invoicing and supply chain to manufacturing, human resources, hospitals and the industry modules.

### Invoicing, Taxes & Discounts

- [Invoicing, Taxes & Discounts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/) (ar: الفواتير والضرائب والخصومات): Invoicing is where a sale turns into money owed — and into a tax-compliant document that both your customer and your government will accept.
- [Setting Up Nama Reward Points](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/reward-points-setup.html) (ar: إعداد نقاط المكافأة في نما (Nama Reward)): This page walks through setting up Nama's own loyalty programme: how customers earn points on their invoices, when those points become usable and when they expire, how they are spent, and how to load opening balances or bar a customer. - entities: RewardPointsConfig, RewardPointCalculatorConfig, RewardPointsOpening, PeriodicRewardPointsGrantDocument, RewardPointsRestriction - screens (ar): إعدادات نقاط المكافأة, نقاط المكافأة للعملاء, سند إفتتاحي نقاط ولاء, سند منح نقاط ولاء فتري, منع احتساب أو صرف نقاط الولاء
- [Customer Reward Points (Loyalty Points)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/reward-points.html) (ar: نقاط مكافآت العملاء (Customer Reward Points / Loyalty Points)): This page covers the messages Nama sends customers about their reward points and the connection to STC Qitaf. - entities: RewardPointsConfig - screens (ar): إعدادات نقاط المكافأة - menu: Basic → Documents → Reward Points Configuration
- [Invoice Discounts and Tax Calculation System - Comprehensive Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/invoice-discounts-and-tax-calculation-guide.html) (ar: دليل نظام الخصومات وحساب الضرائب على الفواتير - دليل شامل): This guide explains how Nama works out the discounts and taxes on an invoice line: which tax configuration a document uses, the order in which discounts and taxes are applied, and the options that change each step. - entities: TaxPlan, TaxDiscountEffectsConfig - screens (ar): سياسة الضريبة, إعدادات تأثير الخصومات و الضرائب - menu: Basic → Master Files → Tax Plan
- [Pricing and Offers Management Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/pricing-and-offers-guide.html) (ar: دليل إدارة الأسعار والعروض (Pricing and Offers Management Guide)): This comprehensive guide covers the pricing system in Nama ERP, including price lists, sales offers, and automated pricing mechanisms that help maintain accurate and competitive pricing throughout your sales processes. - entities: SalesPriceList, SalesOffers - screens (ar): قائمة أسعار, عرض - menu: Sales → Prices And Offers → Price List
- [Salesman Discount Limits](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/salesman-discount-limits.html) (ar: حدود خصم البائع): A shop usually wants a sliding scale of discount authority: a salesperson may knock up to 10% off, the branch manager up to 15%, and anything beyond that needs head office. - entities: Employee - screens (ar): موظف
- [Payment Schedules User Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/payment-schedules-user-guide.html) (ar: دليل المستخدم لجداول الدفع (Payment Schedules)): The Payment Schedules feature in Nama ERP allows you to define flexible payment terms and installment plans for sales documents. - entities: PaymentScheduleTemplate, ReceiptVoucher, PaymentVoucher - screens (ar): نموذج جدولة الدفعات, سند قبض, سند صرف - menu: Purchases → Master Files → Payment Schedule Template
- [Linking Payment Vouchers to Invoices](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/payment-entries.html) (ar: ربط سندات الدفع بالفواتير): Nama ERP supports linking invoices to payment vouchers flexibly across multiple scenarios. - entities: ReceiptVoucher, PaymentVoucher - screens (ar): سند قبض, سند صرف
- [Online Payments Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/online-payments.html) (ar: تكامل المدفوعات الإلكترونية (Online Payments Integration)): Nama ERP's online payment module lets you accept payments directly from your customers through secure payment gateways. - entities: OnlinePaymentConfig, PaymentLinksCreationDoc - screens (ar): سند إنشاء روابط دفع - menu: Basic → Documents → Online Payment Configuration
- [Electronic Invoicing in Nama ERP](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/e-invoices-guide.html) (ar: الفاتورة الإلكترونية في نما ERP): Most tax authorities no longer accept a printed invoice as the record of a sale. - entities: TaxPayerConfiguration, TaxAuthoritySubmissionDoc - screens (ar): إعدادات مصلحة الضرائب, إرسال مستندات الي مصلحة الضرائب - menu: Basic → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration
- [Integration with ZATCA (Saudi Arabia – Fatoora)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/zatca-guide.html) (ar: الربط مع هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك بالسعودية (ZATCA – فاتورة)): The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) requires every VAT-registered business in Saudi Arabia to issue its invoices electronically through the Fatoora platform. - entities: TaxPayerConfiguration, TaxAuthoritySubmissionDoc - screens (ar): إعدادات مصلحة الضرائب, إرسال مستندات الي مصلحة الضرائب - menu: Basic → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration
- [Integration with JoFotara (Jordan)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/jofotara-jordan-guide.html) (ar: التكامل مع «فوترة» الأردنية (JoFotara)): Jordan's Income and Sales Tax Department runs the national e-invoicing portal JoFotara. - entities: TaxPayerConfiguration, TaxAuthoritySubmissionDoc - screens (ar): إعدادات مصلحة الضرائب, إرسال مستندات الي مصلحة الضرائب - menu: Basic → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration
- [Egyptian e-Invoice and e-Receipt](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/egypt-einvoice-guide.html) (ar: الفاتورة الإلكترونية والإيصال الإلكتروني في مصر): The Egyptian Tax Authority runs two electronic systems side by side. - entities: TaxPayerConfiguration, TaxAuthoritySubmissionDoc, DocumentCancelDocument, Bank, BankAccount, DocumentTerm - screens (ar): إعدادات مصلحة الضرائب, إرسال مستندات الي مصلحة الضرائب, مستند إلغاء مستند, بنك, حساب بنكي, توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration
- [UAE E-Invoicing Integration via Orchida osTax](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/uae-orchida-einvoice-guide.html) (ar: الربط مع الفاتورة الإلكترونية في الإمارات عبر Orchida osTax): NamaERP supports sending electronic invoices to the UAE Federal Tax Authority (FTA) through the Orchida osTax service provider. - entities: TaxPayerConfiguration, TaxAuthoritySubmissionDoc - screens (ar): إعدادات مصلحة الضرائب, إرسال مستندات الي مصلحة الضرائب - menu: Basic → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration → Electronic Tax Authority Configuration
- [Standard Terms and Conditions Feature Documentation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/standard-terms-feature-documentation.html) (ar: توثيق خاصية الشروط والأحكام القياسية (Standard Terms and Conditions Feature Documentation)): The Standard Terms feature in Nama ERP provides a comprehensive mechanism for tracking terms and conditions in sales documents (invoices, quotations, etc.) and monitoring whether these terms have been fulfilled. - entities: SalesStandardTerm, StandardTermFulfillment, StandardTermExtension - screens (ar): بند بيع قياسي, تحقق البند, تمديد فترة عمل البند - menu: Basic → Master Files → Sales Standard Term
- [Barcode Field Feature for Sequential Scanning](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/invoicing/barcode-field-feature.html) (ar: ميزة حقل الباركود للمسح المتتالي): A new feature has been developed in Nama ERP to solve the problem of losing focus when scanning item barcodes in browsers.

### Accounting & Banks

- [Accounting & Banks](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/) (ar: الحسابات والبنوك): The NaMa Accounting System is the financial engine of the whole product: every document in Nama — a sales invoice, a stock issue, a payroll run, an asset depreciation — ultimately lands as an accounting effect in the general ledger.
- [Accounting Concepts & First-Time Setup](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/accounting-concepts-and-setup.html) (ar: المفاهيم الأساسية والإعداد المبدئي للحسابات): Before you can record your first entry, the accounting system needs to "know" a few fixed facts about your organization: What is your main currency? - entities: Ledger, AccountChartType, AccountingCalendar, FiscalYear - screens (ar): دفتر حسابات, نوع شجرة حسابات, تقويم, سنة مالية - menu: Accounting → Settings → Ledger - licence: accounting
- [Chart of Accounts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/chart-of-accounts.html) (ar: شجرة الحسابات): The chart of accounts is the backbone of your accounting system: a hierarchical structure that classifies everything you own, owe, earn, and spend into logical, branching groups. - entities: AccountsChart, AccountCategory, AccountTaxCategory - screens (ar): شجرة حسابات, تصنيف حساب, تصنيف حساب ضريبي - menu: Accounting → Master Files → Accounts Chart - licence: accounting
- [Accounts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/accounts.html) (ar: الحسابات): If the chart of accounts is the structure, the Account is the unit balances are actually recorded on. - entities: Account - menu: Accounting → Master Files → Account - licence: accounting
- [System Accounts & Transaction Exceptions](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/system-accounts-and-exceptions.html) (ar: الحسابات النظامية واستثناءات الحركة عليها): Some accounts in the ledger are not meant to be touched by hand. - entities: SystemAccountTransException, Account - screens (ar): استثناءات الحركة على الحسابات النظامية - menu: Accounting → Master Files → System Accounts Transactions Exceptions - licence: accounting
- [Journal Entries & Adjustments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/journal-entries.html) (ar: سندات القيد والتسويات): Most entries in Nama are generated automatically from other documents (an invoice, a stock issue, a payroll run...), but there's always a need to record manual entries: an adjustment, a petty expense, an opening balance, clearing a suspense account. - entities: JournalEntry, CurrencyDiffJournal, ExchangeRateUpdate, InterCompanyTransfer - screens (ar): سند قيد, سند قيد فرق عملة, سند تغيير سعر صرف, جارى تحويل شركات - menu: Accounting → Documents → Journal Entry - licence: accounting, accounting-banks
- [Year-End Closing & Period Control](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/year-end-and-period-control.html) (ar: الإقفال السنوي والتحكم في الفترات): At the end of each fiscal year comes the moment of closing: carrying the year's profit/loss into equity, and closing the result accounts in preparation for a new year. - entities: ClosingEntry, PreventAccTransactions, LedgerReviseDoc - screens (ar): قيد ختامي, منع الحركات على حسابات او ذممم, سند مراجعة حسابات - menu: Accounting → Documents → Closing Entry - licence: accounting
- [Receipt & Payment Vouchers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/receipts-and-payments.html) (ar: سندات القبض والصرف): The receipt and payment chain: requests, orders and vouchers, the receipt voucher screen, its accounting effect, consolidated requests, actions, reports, and preventing a payment from overdrawing the cash box. - entities: ReceiptVoucher, PaymentVoucher, ReceiptOrder, PaymentOrder, RVRequest, PVRequest, ConsolidatedRVRequest, ConsolidatedPVRequest - screens (ar): سند قبض, سند صرف, أمر قبض, أمر صرف, طلب قبض, طلب صرف, طلب قبض مجمع, طلب صرف مجمع - menu: Accounting → Documents → Receipt Voucher - licence: accounting
- [Credit & Debit Notes](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/credit-and-debit-notes.html) (ar: إشعارات الدائن والمدين): How the Credit Note and Debit Note documents adjust a customer's or supplier's balance without cash: the screen fields, settling the related invoice, the accounting effect, actions and reports. - entities: CreditNote, DebitNote - screens (ar): إشعار دائن, إشعار مدين - menu: Accounting → Documents → CreditNote - licence: accounting
- [Aging Allocation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/aging-allocation.html) (ar: تسوية أعمار الديون (Aging Allocation)): The Aging Allocation document: manually matching a party's open debit and credit items so debt-age reports are right, the steps on the screen, what saving does, and reading matches for custom aging reports. - entities: AgingAllocation - menu: Banks → Master Files → Aging Allocation
- [Cashier Shifts (Cash Drawer)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/cashier-shifts.html) (ar: ورديات الكاشير (درج النقدية)): The general receipt and payment vouchers (see their page) are flexible but more detailed than a cashier needs when handling dozens of quick payments a day. - entities: CSHOpenShift, CSHCloseShift, CSHReceiptVoucher, CSHPaymentVoucher, ElectronicReceiptVoucher - screens (ar): سند فتح وردية, سند غلق وردية, سند قبض كاشير, سند صرف كاشير, سند قبض إلكتروني - menu: Accounting → Cashiers → Open Shift - licence: accounting-cashier, accounting-electronic-receipt
- [Banks, Bank Accounts & Transfers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/banks-and-bank-accounts.html) (ar: البنوك والحسابات البنكية والتحويلات): Managing the banking side starts by defining the banks you deal with, then the bank accounts opened with them. - entities: Bank, BankAccount, BankTransfer, BankAdjustment - screens (ar): حساب بنكي, تحويل بنكي, تسوية بنكية - menu: Banks → Master Files → Bank - licence: accounting-banks
- [Bank Reconciliation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/bank-reconciliation.html) (ar: المطابقة البنكية): Your bank balance in your books rarely matches the bank statement moment for moment: a cheque you deposited isn't yet collected, a fee the bank deducted you haven't recorded yet, a transfer in transit. - entities: BankReconciliation - screens (ar): مذكرة تسوية بنكية - menu: Banks → Cheques → Bank Reconciliation - licence: accounting-banks
- [Cheques & Financial Papers (Lifecycle)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/cheques-financial-papers.html) (ar: الشيكات والأوراق المالية (دورة الحياة)): A cheque isn't just an amount; it's a paper with a journey: it's received, deposited at the bank, collected or returned, and may be endorsed to another party or discounted before its due date. - entities: FinancialPaper, FPBook, BankPortfolio, BankNotice, OpenningFinancialPaper, FinancialPaperAgio, FinancialPaperCancel, FPTransfer - screens (ar): ورقة تجارية, دفتر أوراق تجارية, حافظة بنكية, إشعار بنكي, إفتتاح ورقة تجارية, أجيو, إلغاء ورقة تجارية, نقل ورقه مالية - menu: Banks → Master Files → Commercial Paper - licence: accounting-banks
- [Bank Loans](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/bank-loans.html) (ar: القروض البنكية): A bank loan isn't just an amount that lands in your account and then gets repaid; it's a commitment that stretches over months or years, with a principal, interest, fees and an installment schedule... - entities: BankLoan, BankLoanRequest, LoanIssue, LoanInstallmentPayment, LoanInterestsCalculation, BankLoanScheduling, BankLoanChangingDoc, BankLoanType - screens (ar): قرض بنكي, طلب إضافة قرض, سند إصدار قرض, سداد أقساط القرض, سند احتساب فوائد القرض, جدولة قرض بنكي, تعديل قرض, نوع القرض - menu: Banks → Bank Loans → Bank Loan - licence: accounting-loans
- [Fixed Deposits](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/fixed-deposits.html) (ar: الودائع الثابتة): A fixed deposit is the mirror image of a loan: instead of borrowing from the bank, you place an amount with it for a set term in return for interest. - entities: FixedDeposit, FixedDepositIssue, InterestPaymentDocument, FixedDepositChangingDoc - screens (ar): وديعة بنكية, إصدار وديعة, سند إصدار أرباح, سند تعديل وديعة - menu: Banks → Fixed Deposits → Fixed Deposit - licence: accounting-loans
- [Credit Facilities & Facility Limits](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/credit-facilities.html) (ar: التسهيلات الائتمانية وحدود التسهيلات): How bank facility limits (a shared ceiling consumed by loans, guarantees and letters of credit) and credit facilities (issued, repaid and terminated through their own documents) are set up and tracked. - entities: CreditFacility, FacilityLimit, FacilityLimitConfig, CreditFacilitySetting, CreditFacilityIssuance, CreditFacilityPayment, CreditFacilityTermination - screens (ar): تسهيل ائتمانى, حد التسهيلات, إعدادات حد التسهيلات, إعدادات التسهيلات الائتمانية, إصدار تسهيل ائتمانى, مستند سداد تسهيل ائتمانى, مستند انهاء تسهيل ائتمانى - menu: Banks → Credit Facilities → Credit Facility - licence: accounting-loans
- [Letters of Guarantee](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/letters-of-guarantee.html) (ar: خطابات الضمان): A letter of guarantee is an undertaking the bank issues on your behalf in favor of a third party (a government body, a project owner…) guaranteeing that you'll meet some obligation — like a tender-entry guarantee or a contract performance guarantee. - entities: LetterOfGuarantee, LGTIssue, LGTReceipt, LGTDelivery, LGTChanging, LGTClosing, LGTReq - screens (ar): خطاب ضمان, إصدار خطاب ضمان, استلام  خطاب ضمان, تسليم  خطاب ضمان, تعديل خطاب ضمان, إنهاء خطاب ضمان, طلب خطاب ضمان - menu: Banks → Letters Of Guarantee → Letter Of Guarantee - licence: accounting-lgt
- [Bank Letters of Credit](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/bank-letters-of-credit.html) (ar: الاعتمادات المستندية البنكية): A letter of credit (LC) is a tool an importer uses to reassure the supplier: the bank undertakes to pay the supplier the shipment's value once they present shipping documents matching the terms. - entities: BankLC, BLCOpeningDoc, BLCChanging, BLCClosingDoc, BLCReq - screens (ar): اعتماد بنكى, فتح اعتماد بنكى, تعديل اعتماد بنكى, إنهاء اعتماد بنكى, طلب اعتماد بنكى - menu: Banks → Bank LC → Bank LC - licence: accounting-blc
- [Treasury Bills](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/treasury-bills.html) (ar: أذون الخزانة): A treasury bill is a short-term investment instrument the state issues: you buy it for less than its nominal value, and at maturity you collect its full value, so the difference is your return. - entities: TreasuryBill, TreasuryBillPurchaseDoc, TrasureyBillROIProofDoc, AggTreasuryBillProofDoc, TreasuryBillSalesDoc, TreasuryBillCloseDoc - screens (ar): إذن خزانة, شراء إذن خزانة, إثبات عائد إذن الخزانة, إثبات عائد أذون خزانة مجمع, بيع إذن خزانة, إقفال إذن خزانة - menu: Banks → Treasury Bill → Treasury Bill - licence: accounting-investment-documents
- [Investment Portfolios](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/investment-portfolios.html) (ar: المحافظ الاستثمارية): When a company puts money into ventures — a stake in another business, a project, a managed fund — it needs to track each investment as an asset in its own right: how much capital went in, what it's worth now, what profit it threw off... - entities: IPInvestmentPortfolio, IPInvestmentStart, IPInvestmentEnd, IPInvestmentUpdate, IPInvestmentProfitDistribution, IPInvestmentIncreaseCapital, IPInvestmentOpportunity, Investor, InvestmentProject - screens (ar): محفظة استثمارية, فتح استثمار, إنهاء استثمار, تحديث الاستثمار, توزيع أرباح الاستثمار, زيادة رأس مال الاستثمار, فرصة استثمارية, مستثمر, مشروع استثماري - menu: Accounting → Investment Portfolios → Investment Portfolio - licence: accounting-investment
- [Investment Documents & Fund Certificates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/investment-documents.html) (ar: مستندات الاستثمار وشهادات الصناديق): Beyond the portfolio system that tracks investment assets, Nama has a second investment world for the paper instruments a company buys and holds: bonds and fund certificates. - entities: InvestmentDoc, InvestmentDocumentFund, InvestmentDocPurchase, InvestmentDocROIProof, AggregatedInvestmentDocROIProof, InvestmentDocClaiming, InvestmentDocumentPurchase, InvestmentDocumentSale, InvestmentDocumentPriceUpdate, ProfitDistributationDoc - screens (ar): سند استثمار, صندوق استثمار وثيقة, مستند شراء سند استثمار, مستند إثبات عائد سندات استثمار, مستند إثبات عائد سندات استثمار مجمع, مستند استحقاق سند استثمار, مستند شراء وثائق استثمار, مستند بيع وثيقة, تغيير سعر الوثيقة, مستند توزيع أرباح - menu: Banks → Investment Documents → Investment Document - licence: accounting-investment-documents
- [Prepaid Expenses](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/prepaid-expenses.html) (ar: المصروفات المقدمة): Some expenses are paid once but belong to many months: an annual rent paid up front, a yearly insurance premium, a maintenance contract. - entities: PrepaidExpenseContract, PrepaidExpenseItem, PrepaidExpenseLedger, PrepaidExpensePayment - screens (ar): عقد مصروف مقدم, بند مصروف مقدم, قيد استحقاق مصروف مقدم, سداد مصروف مقدم - menu: Accounting → Prepaid Expense Contracts → Prepaid Expense Contract - licence: accounting-prepaid-expenses
- [Financial Commitments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/financial-commitments.html) (ar: الالتزامات المالية): A company carries many recurring obligations that aren't invoices yet but are very real: a yearly rent paid in quarterly installments, an insurance policy, a financing agreement with a fixed repayment schedule. - entities: FinancialCommitment, FinancialCommitmentPayDoc, FinancialCommitmentReschedule, FinancialCommitmentCategory - screens (ar): إلتزام مالى, مستند دفع إلتزام مالى, مستند إعادة جدولة إلتزام مالى, فئة إلتزام مالى - menu: Accounting → Financial Commitment Management → Financial Commitment - licence: accounting-financial-commitments-regulation
- [Financial Budgets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/financial-budgets.html) (ar: الموازنات المالية): A budget is a plan with teeth: you decide up front how much each account may spend (or should earn) over a period, and then — if you want — the system holds your documents to that plan, warning or even blocking spending that would blow past it. - entities: FinancialBudget, BudgetScenario - screens (ar): موازنه مالية, سيناريو موازنة - menu: BUDGETS → Budgets → Financial Budget - licence: accounting-budget
- [Financial Statements](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/financial-statements.html) (ar: القوائم المالية): Every company needs an income statement and a balance sheet, but no two companies want them laid out exactly the same way — different line groupings, different subtotals, different comparison columns. - entities: FSSettingsFile, FSIssueFile, FSAccountGroup, FSEquation - screens (ar): إعدادات قائمة مالية, إصدار قائمة مالية, مجموعة حساب, معادلة - menu: Accounting → Financial Statement → FS Settings File - licence: accounting
- [Consolidated Statements](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/consolidated-statements.html) (ar: القوائم المالية الموحدة): The consolidated statements give a group of companies one trial balance, one income statement and one balance sheet, in one reporting currency, with the business the companies did with each other taken out. - licence: accounting
- [Misc Purchasing & Machine Rent](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/misc-purchasing.html) (ar: المشتريات المتنوعة وتشغيل المعدات): Not every purchase flows through the inventory module. - entities: MiscPurchaseInvoice, MiscPurchaseReq, MiscPurchaseOrder, PurchaseElement, MachineRentInvoice - screens (ar): فاتورة متنوعات, طلب شراء متنوعات, أمر شراء متنوعات, بند شراء, فاتورة تشغيل معدات - menu: Accounting → Documents → Miscellaneous Invoice - licence: accounting
- [Party Evaluation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/party-evaluation.html) (ar: تقييم الجهات): How to score customers, suppliers and banks with Party Evaluation: defining evaluation elements and element groups with weights, and recording a party's evaluation. - entities: PartyEvaluation, PartyEvaluationElement, PartyEvalElementGroup - screens (ar): تقييم جهة, عنصر تقييم جهة, مجموعة نقاط تقييم جهة - menu: Accounting → Party Evaluations → Party Evaluation - licence: accounting
- [Subsidiary Reconciliation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/subsidiary-reconciliation.html) (ar: التسوية مع الذمم): How Subsidiary Reconciliation compares your books for a customer or supplier with their external statement in three steps, matches what agrees and lists the differences, with no accounting effect. - entities: SubsidiaryReconciliation - screens (ar): تسوية مع ذمة - menu: Accounting → Reconciliations → Subsidiary Reconciliation - licence: accounting
- [Account Statements, Trial Balance & Analysis](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/reports-account-statements-and-trial-balance.html) (ar: كشوف الحسابات وميزان المراجعة والتحليل): Once transactions are recorded, the moment of questions arrives: What is this account's balance? - licence: accounting

#### Technical Reference

- [Technical Reference](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/support/) (ar: مرجع الدعم الفني)
- [When a Document Has No Accounting Effect](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/support/accounting-request-processing.html) (ar: حين لا يكون للمستند أثر محاسبي): Saving an accounting document does not write its journal entry there and then. - menu: Administration → Settings → Business Requests
- [Accounting Configuration (module option catalog)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/support/accounting-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات الحسابات (كتالوج خيارات الوحدة)): Many of the accounting module's behaviors aren't coded — they're configured from the accounting module's configuration screen (Module Configurations → Account Configurations). - menu: Module Configurations → Account Configurations
- [Document Terms (per-type processing rules)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/support/accounting-document-terms.html) (ar: توجيهات المستندات (قواعد المعالجة لكل نوع)): One question recurs throughout this module's guides: "where do the debit and credit accounts for this document come from?" - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Dimensions, Cost Centers & Distribution](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/support/accounting-dimensions-and-distribution.html) (ar: المحدِّدات ومراكز التكلفة والتوزيع): The dimensions carried on ledger lines (legal entity, sector, branch, department, analysis set and more), restricting dimensions per account, and Account Distribution for spreading a value across them. - entities: AccDistribution - screens (ar): توزيع حسابات - menu: Accounting → Settings → Account Distribution
- [Fiscal Periods, Period Locking & Multi-Currency](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/support/accounting-periods-and-currency.html) (ar: الفترات المالية وإقفال الفترات وتعدّد العملات): Fiscal years and periods, opening and locking periods, and how documents in more than one currency are handled: why a document will not save into a date and why a foreign-currency balance changes. - entities: FiscalYear, FiscalYearStatusUpdate - screens (ar): سنة مالية, تحديث حالة السنة المالية - menu: Basic → Master Files → Fiscal Year

#### Accounting Document Terms

- [Accounting Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/) (ar: توجيهات مستندات الحسابات): Every accounting document that posts takes its accounts from its document term (توجيه) — so when a voucher lands on the wrong account, a cheque moves to an unexpected status, or a letter of guarantee posts nothing...
- [Receipt, Payment and Request Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-vouchers-and-requests.html) (ar: توجيهات سندات القبض والصرف والطلبات): Receipt and payment vouchers are the most configured documents in the accounting module, and their term is the longest in it — well over fifty options. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Journal, Closing and Other Accounting Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-journals-and-closing.html) (ar: توجيهات القيود والإقفال ومستندات الحسابات الأخرى): A journal entry's lines name their own accounts, so its term has no debit and credit sides to fill — it is about guard rails instead: which dimensions a user may change, and what to do when the entry does not balance. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Credit/Debit Note and Miscellaneous Invoice Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-notes-and-misc-invoices.html) (ar: توجيهات الإشعارات الدائنة والمدينة وفواتير المتنوعات): Credit and debit notes adjust what a customer or supplier owes without moving goods, and the miscellaneous invoices bill things that are not stock items — services, rent, utilities, machine hire. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Commercial Paper Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-commercial-papers.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات الأوراق التجارية): Document term settings for the commercial paper (cheque) documents: opening papers, bank portfolio, bank notice, partial payment, cancellation, agio and FP transfer, and the accounts each one moves value between. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Letter of Guarantee and Letter of Credit Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-guarantees-and-credits.html) (ar: توجيهات خطابات الضمان والاعتمادات البنكية): A letter of guarantee moves several different amounts at once: the face value the bank commits to, the cash cover the bank holds back from your account, the fees it charges, and the share of your credit facility the letter uses up. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Loan, Deposit and Credit Facility Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-loans-deposits-facilities.html) (ar: توجيهات القروض والودائع والتسهيلات الائتمانية): Borrowing from a bank and lending to one are mirror images, and their terms look alike: a pair of sides for the principal, a pair for the interest, and sometimes a pair for the fees. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Investment and Prepaid Expense Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/accounting/document-terms/acc-terms-investments-and-prepaid.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات الاستثمار والمصروفات المقدمة): Investments and prepaid expenses have one thing in common: the value on day one is not the value that ends up in profit and loss. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

### Supply Chain

- [Supply Chain](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/) (ar: سلسلة التوريد): Welcome to the Supply Chain Management module - the heart of how NaMa ERP helps you track, manage, and control the flow of goods through your organization.
- [Understanding Inventory Items](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/understanding-items.html) (ar: فهم أصناف المخزون (Understanding Inventory Items)): Let's talk about Items - the building blocks of the entire supply chain system. - entities: InvItem - screens (ar): صنف - menu: Inventory → Master Files → Item
- [Creating and Maintaining Items](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/item-maintenance.html) (ar: إنشاء الأصناف وصيانتها (Creating and Maintaining Items)): This page covers the screens that surround the item card — opening items in bulk, changing them after the fact, deciding who is allowed to buy them, and telling the warehouse where they belong. - entities: InvItemOpiningRequest, MultiItemCreator, ItemConfigurations, InvItemUpdate, ItemCustomerLink, ItemSupplierLink, ItemRelations, ItemStorageAllocation - screens (ar): طلب فتح صنف, أصناف متعددة, إعدادات صنف, تحديث بيانات صنف, ربط صنف بعميل, ربط صنف بمورد, علاقات أصناف, تحديد تخزين أصناف
- [Item Classification Files](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/item-classification-files.html) (ar: ملفات تصنيف الأصناف (Item Classification Files)): The item classification master files: Item Class 1 to 10, Item Category, Item Section, Item Brand, colours and sizes, item revisions, the size-colour-revision collection and item assortments. - entities: ItemClass1, ItemCategory, ItemSection, ItemBrand, ItemColor, ItemSize, ItemColorClassification, ItemSizeClassification, ItemRevisionFile, ItemSizeColorCollection, ItemAssortment - screens (ar): تصنيف صنف 1, فئة صنف, قسم صنف, ماركة صنف, لون صنف, مقاس صنف, تصنيف لون صنف, تصنيف مقاس صنف, اصدار صنف, مصفوفة ألوان ومقاسات و إصدارات, تشكيلة ألوان ومقاسات
- [Units of Measure](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/units-of-measure.html) (ar: وحدات القياس (Units of Measure)): Nama holds every item's stock in one single unit and lets each document speak a different one, so a distributor can buy a product by the carton, sell it by the piece and report on it by the litre without anyone doing the arithmetic by hand. - entities: UOM, UOMGroup, UOMConversions, StandardMeasures, CalculationFormula, InvItem - screens (ar): وحدة قياس, مجموعة وحدات, تحويل وحدات, أبعاد قياسية, صيغة حسابية, صنف
- [Warehouses & Locators](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/warehouses-and-locators.html) (ar: المخازن والمواقع التخزينية (Warehouses & Locators)): Warehouses and locators: warehouse types, keepers and MRP inclusion, locators inside a warehouse, item-warehouse links, warehouse groups, the Warehouse Usage Policy and Prevent Using Batch. - entities: Warehouse, Locator, WarehouseUsagePolicy, PreventUsingBatch, WarehouseGroup, WareLocationClass, ItemWarehouseRelation - screens (ar): مخزن, موقع, سياسة استخدام المخازن, منع إستخدام الشحنة, مجموعة مخازن, تصنيف الموقع المخزني, ربط أصناف بمخزن - menu: Inventory → Master Files → Warehouse
- [The Anatomy of a Supply Chain Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/the-document-screen.html) (ar: تشريح مستند سلسلة التوريد (The Anatomy of a Supply Chain Document)): Every supply chain document — a sales invoice, a purchase invoice, an order, a stock receipt, an issue, a transfer — is built from the same handful of parts... - entities: SalesInvoice, PurchaseInvoice - screens (ar): فاتورة مبيعات, فاتورة مشتريات
- [Receiving Stock](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/receiving-stock.html) (ar: استلام المخزون في المستودع (Receiving Stock)): Receiving stock: the Stock Receipt and Stock Receipt Request, opening stock documents, receiving damaged goods, receipt inspection, and correcting or cancelling receipts. - entities: StockReceipt, StockReceiptReq, InitialReceipt, PurgeStockReceipt, ReceiptInspection, StockReceiptCancellation, OpeningStockDocument - screens (ar): توريد مخزني, طلب توريد مخزني, إستلام مبدئي, فحص توريد مخزني, سند إلغاء توريد, سند افتتاح مخزني - menu: Inventory → Receipt Documents → Stock Receipt
- [Issuing Stock](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/issuing-stock.html) (ar: إصدار المخزون من المستودع (Issuing Stock)): Issuing stock: the Stock Issue for internal use, samples, losses and damage, the Stock Issue Request, cutting two-dimensional materials, batch and serial selection, the accounting effect and corrections. - entities: StockIssue, StockIssueReq, ItemCuttingDoc - screens (ar): صرف مخزني, طلب صرف مخزني, سند قص أصناف - menu: Inventory → Receipt Documents → Stock Issue
- [Moving Stock Between Warehouses](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/moving-stock.html) (ar: تحريك المخزون بين المخازن (Moving Stock)): Moving stock between warehouses: the one-step Stock Transfer, the two-step issue and receipt transfers, stock transfer requests and aggregated requests, and transfers between companies. - entities: StockTransfer, IssueStockTransfer, ReceiptStockTransfer, StockTransferReq, AggrStockTransferReq - screens (ar): سند تحويل مخزني, صرف تحويل مخزني, استلام تحويل مخزني, طلب تحويل مخزني, طلب تحويل مخزني مجمع - menu: Inventory → Stock transfer Docs → Stock Transfer
- [Stock Taking](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/stock-taking.html) (ar: الجرد المخزني (Stock Taking)): Stock taking: the Start and End Stock Taking documents, entering counts in Stock Taking Details or electronically, the surplus and shortage documents it generates, and handling natural loss. - entities: StartStockTaking, EndStockTaking, StockTakingDetails, StockTakingElectronic - screens (ar): بداية جرد مخزني, نهاية الجرد, لجنة جرد مخزني, لجنة جرد إلكترونى
- [Inventory Costing & Revaluation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/inventory-costing.html) (ar: تكلفة المخزون وإعادة التقييم (Inventory Costing & Revaluation)): Inventory quantity is only half the truth; the other half is its value. - entities: ReceiptAdditionalCost, CostRevaluation, FinishedProductPricing, FrozenCostAccounts - screens (ar): تكاليف إستلام إضافية, إعادة تقييم المخزون, تسعير منتج نهائى, إيقاف تأثير التكاليف على الحسابات
- [The Purchasing Journey](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/purchasing-journey.html) (ar: رحلة الشراء (The Purchasing Journey)): Let's follow the complete story of how items get purchased - from "we need something" to "it's in our warehouse and we've paid for it." - entities: PurchaseOrder, PurchaseInvoice, ItemRequest, PurchaseQuotation, PurchaseQuotationRequest, PurchasePriceComparing, ConsolidatedPurchaseReq, PurchaseReturn, PurchaseReturnReq, ProformaPurchaseInvoice, PurchaseDocumentUpdate - screens (ar): أمر شراء, فاتورة مشتريات, طلب شراء, عرض أسعار مشتريات, طلب عرض أسعار مشتريات, مقارنة أسعار مشتريات, طلب شراء مجمع, مردودات مشتريات, طلب مردودات مشتريات, فاتورة شراء مبدئية, تعديل سندات شراء
- [How a Purchase Price Is Decided](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/purchase-pricing.html) (ar: كيف يُحدَّد سعر الشراء (How a Purchase Price Is Decided)): Every purchase order and purchase invoice line needs a unit price, and in most companies nobody types it by hand: the figure arrives from a Purchase Price List, gets cut down by a Vendor Discount agreement... - entities: PurchasePriceList, VendorDiscount, InvoiceClassification - screens (ar): قائمة أسعار المشتريات, خصومات مورد, تصنيف الفواتير
- [Purchase Forecast](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/purchase-forecast.html) (ar: التنبؤ بالمشتريات (Purchase Forecast)): The best purchase is the one made before you run out, not after. - entities: NewPurchaseForecast, PurchaseForecastConfig, PFSalesSourceConfig, PFQuantitySource - screens (ar): توقعات مشتريات, إعدادات توقعات المشتريات, إعدادات مصدر المبيعات, مصدر الكميات - menu: Purchases → New Purchase Forecast → New Purchase Forecast
- [The Sales Journey](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/sales-journey.html) (ar: رحلة المبيعات (The Sales Journey)): The sales journey is the mirror image of purchasing - instead of bringing items in, you're selling and delivering them to customers. - entities: SalesInvoice, SalesOrder, SalesQuotation, SalesQuotationRequest, ProformaSalesInvoice, SalesReturn, SalesReturnRequest, SalesReplacement, SalesForecast - screens (ar): فاتورة مبيعات, أمر بيع, عرض أسعار, طلب عرض أسعار, فاتورة بيع مبدئية, مردودات مبيعات, طلب مردودات مبيعات, سند استبدال مبيعات, موازنة المبيعات
- [Sales and Purchase Operations Documents](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/sales-operations-documents.html) (ar: مستندات العمليات في المبيعات والمشتريات (Sales and Purchase Operations Documents)): Eight small screens sit around the trading cycle, each doing exactly one job: parking a shortage the salesman just hit, swapping goods under approval, releasing a reservation, moving a batch of customers to another salesman... - entities: CustomersReqsShortageDoc, SalesReplacementReq, ReservationCancellationDoc, SalesManUpdateDocument, PurchaseOrderStatusChange, LimitSalesQty, DiscountUpdate, DiscountsReCalcDocument - screens (ar): مستند نواقص طلبات العملاء, طلب استبدال مبيعات, سند إلغاء حجز, سند تحديث مندوب المبيعات, مستند تغيير حالة أمر الشراء, تحديد كميات الصنف للعميل, تعديل الخصومات, أعادة حساب الخصومات
- [Pricing, Offers & Coupons](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/pricing-offers-and-coupons.html) (ar: التسعير والعروض والكوبونات (Pricing, Offers & Coupons)): The price a customer pays isn't a single number, but the result of several layers: a price list, a quantity discount, a promotional offer, and maybe a coupon. - entities: SalesPriceList, SalesOffers, DiscountCoupon, PostSalesOffer, PostSalesOfferConfig, PostSalesOfferClaim, PriceVotingDoc, PricingRange, AutoSalesPricing, SalesPriceInPoints, FreeItemGroup, PeriodicMonthlySalesOffer, DiscountCouponType, DiscountCouponBook, SalesCouponsCodingMethod, CouponsSalesOrder, CouponsSalesOrderReturn, PriceVotingFile, AutoSalesPricingSetting, Season, UpdateSeasonsDoc - screens (ar): قائمة أسعار, عرض, قسيمة خصومات, عرض ما بعد البيع, إعدادات عروض ما بعد البيع, مطالبة عرض ما بعد البيع, مستند التصويت على الأسعار, مدى تطبيق الأسعار, ملف تسعير مبيعات آلي, قوائم الأسعار بالنقاط, مجموعة مجانية, عروض المبيعات الفترية, نوع قسيمة خصومات, دفتر قسيمة خصومات, طريقة تكويد قسائم البيع, أمر بيع قسائم, مردود أمر بيع قسائم, ملف التصويت على الأسعار, إعدادات تسعير مبيعات آلي, موسم, مستند تحديث المواسم
- [Offer Apply Rules](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/offer-apply-rules.html) (ar: قواعد تطبيق العروض (Offer Apply Rules)): An Offer Apply Rule is a named, reusable filter that tells an invoice-level promotion which lines of a document it is actually about. - entities: OfferApplyRules - menu: Sales → Prices And Offers → Offer Apply Rules
- [Comprehensive Reservation System Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/reservation-system-guide.html) (ar: دليل نظام الحجوزات الشامل (Comprehensive Reservation System Guide)): This guide provides comprehensive documentation for the Reservation System in Nama ERP, intended for technical support staff and system administrators. - entities: ReservationDocument - screens (ar): سند حجز - menu: Inventory → Reservation Documents → Reservation Document
- [Delivery & Loading](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/delivery-and-loading.html) (ar: التسليم والتحميل (Delivery & Loading)): Between confirming the sales order and issuing the invoice lies the physical stage: preparing the goods, loading them, getting them to the customer, and obtaining proof of receipt. - entities: DeliveryDocument, LoadingDocument, DeliveryQueue, PickRules, DeliveryCancellationDoc, LoadingCancellationDoc, DeliveryQueueConfiguration, DeliveryDriverConfig, DeliveryOrganization - screens (ar): سند توصيل, سند التحميل, طابور تسليم, قواعد السحب, سند إلغاء توصيل, سند إلغاء تحميل, ملف إعدادات طابور التسليم, ملف إعدادات السائقين, منظمة التوصيل للسائقين

#### Assembly & Packaging

- [Quality Control](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/quality-control.html) (ar: ضبط الجودة (Quality Control)): Quality control and quality assurance requests and documents, inspection checklists, and how inspection ties into receiving and production before stock becomes available. - entities: QualityControlDoc, QualityControlReq, QualityAssuranceDoc, QualityAssuranceReq, QualityCheckList, QuestionClassification - screens (ar): مستند فحص جودة, طلب فحص جودة, سند تاكيد الجودة, طلب تأكيد جودة, قائمة تحقق جودة, تصنيف سؤال
- [Import Letters of Credit](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/letters-of-credit.html) (ar: الاعتمادات المستندية للاستيراد (Letters of Credit)): When you import goods from a supplier abroad, both parties need a guarantee: the supplier wants assured payment, and you want assured conforming shipment. - entities: LetterOfCredit, LCShipment, LCOpeningDoc, LcExpenseDocument, LetterOfCreditRequest, LCOpeningRequest, LCCostDoc, LCAction, LCProformaInvoice, LCShipmentProformaInvoice - screens (ar): الإعتماد المستندي, شحنة, فتح إعتماد, سند مصروفات, طلب إعتماد مستندي, طلب فتح إعتماد, سند تكليف, إجراء, فاتورة مبدئية, فاتورة مبدئية للشحنة - menu: LC → Master Files → Letter Of Credit
- [Weight Scale](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/weight-scale.html) (ar: موازين الوزن (Weight Scale)): In facilities that handle bulk materials sold or received by weight - grains, concrete, aggregates, metals - the scale becomes part of the workflow. - entities: WeightScaleConfig, WeightScalePreparationDoc, WeightScalePrepGenerator - screens (ar): إعدادات الميزان, سند تحضير - الميزان, سند إنشاء سندات تحضير الميزان - menu: Inventory → Weight Scale → Weight Scale Configuration
- [Specialized Scenarios](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/specialized-scenarios.html) (ar: سيناريوهات متخصصة (Specialized Scenarios)): Specialized supply chain scenarios: glass job orders and their operations, Service Item BOMs, document automation tools, tenders, and resources and activities. - entities: GlassJobOrder, GlassJobOrderReq, GlassOperationMap, ServiceItemBOM, OrderExecution, GlassJobOrderStatusUpdate, OrderDelivery, OrderFinished, OutsourceRequest, OutsourceIssue, OutsourceReceipt, OrderDamage, JOrderExpense, Tender, TenderCondition, SCDocRuleSet, SCExtraDocCreationRule, SCCopierExtraFields, OrderStatusQtyTrackConfig, DeliveryConfiguration, Resource, Activity, MaterialClassification - screens (ar): أمر شغل زجاج, طلب أمر شغل زجاج, عمليات تشغيل زجاج, تفاصيل التشغيل, تنفيذ تشغيلة, تغيير حالة أمر شغل, تسليم عميل, إنهاء وتسليم لصالة التسليم, طلب تصنيع خارجي, صرف لتصنيع خارجي, استلام تصنيع خارجي, سند تلفيات, مصاريف على أمر شغل, مناقصة, شرط مناقصة, قائمة قواعد, قاعدة إنشاء مستندات  مخزنية, الحقول الإضافية لإنشاء المستندات, إعدادات  مصدر متابعة الكميات, ملف إعدادات التوصيل, مورد تشغيل, نشاط, تصنيف الخامة
- [Ignoring Specific Warehouses/Locators in Reservation Quantity Check by Date](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/ignore-reservation-qty-check-by-date.html) (ar: تجاهل مخازن/مواقع معينة في التحقق من كمية الحجز بالتاريخ): This feature allows you to exclude specific warehouses or locators from the overdraft-by-date check calculation when performing Reservation operations only. - entities: Warehouse, Locator, ConfigEntry - screens (ar): مخزن, موقع, إعدادات النظام
- [Supply Chain and Sales Reports](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/supplychain-reports.html) (ar: تقارير سلسلة التوريد والمبيعات (Supply Chain and Sales Reports)): Catalogue of the 77 system reports for inventory, purchasing, sales and point of sale: where to run them, their shared criteria conventions, and each report's code, names and purpose.
- [FAQ — Distribution, Warehousing, Sales & Purchasing Module](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/supply-chain-faq.html) (ar: أسئلة في موديول التوزيع والمخازن والمبيعات والمشتريات): Answers to questions support often gets about stock, sales and purchasing: capping quantities, tying items to warehouses, which price an invoice picks, costing bundles and purchase returns, and the three kinds of stock transfer.

#### Development Request Notes

- [Development Request Notes](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/development-requests/) (ar: ملاحظات طلبات التطوير): Index of Supply Chain development request notes: untagged quantities for batch and expiry items before a cut-off date, and stock receipts for the unsatisfied part of a purchase order.
- [Allowing Items With Batch & Expiry to Hold Untagged Quantities](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/development-requests/allow-empty-item-dimensions-before-date.html) (ar: السماح للأصناف ذات الدفعات وتواريخ الصلاحية بحمل كميات غير موسومة (Allowing Items With Batch & Expiry to Hold Untagged Quantities)): Development request SRDRQ06261: the per-dimension cut-off date on Item Configurations that lets items tracked by batch, serial or other dimensions keep moving untagged stock dated before it. - entities: ItemConfigurations - screens (ar): إعدادات صنف - menu: Inventory → Settings → Item Configurations
- [Stock Receipts for the Unsatisfied Part of a Purchase Order](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/development-requests/stock-receipt-for-unsatisfied-order-quantities.html) (ar: سند توريد مخزني للجزء غير المنفّذ من أمر الشراء (Stock Receipts for the Unsatisfied Part of a Purchase Order)): Development request SRDRQ06178: term options that keep a stock receipt in step with a purchase order's unsatisfied quantity, hide fully executed orders, and date or split receipts a purchase invoice generates. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

#### Document Terms

- [Document Terms (Modules › Supply Chain)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/) (ar: توجيهات المستندات): A Document Term (توجيه المستند) is the main mechanism for customizing how a Supply Chain document type behaves.
- [General Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-general.html) (ar: إعدادات عامة (General)): A Document Term (توجيه المستند) is the main mechanism for customizing how a document type behaves in Nama — one document type can have several terms, each shaping its validation, generation, pricing, accounting and more. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [From-Document Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-from-document.html) (ar: إعدادات النسخ من المستند (From-Document)): The from document (بناءً على) is the source document a new document is created from — for example a Sales Order that a Sales Invoice is built on. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Sub-Item Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-sub-item.html) (ar: إعدادات الصنف الفرعي (Sub-Item)): A sub-item (الصنف الفرعي) is a serialized/tracked sub-unit of an item that carries its own warehouse, locator, taxes, status and back-links to the documents that created or touched it. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Quantity Tracking Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-quantity-tracking.html) (ar: إعدادات متابعة الكميات (Quantity Tracking)): These settings control quantity tracking — the engine that links documents and records how much of a source document has been satisfied by the documents created from it (for example, how much of a Sales Order has been invoiced or delivered). - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Reservation & Delivery System](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-reservation-and-delivery.html) (ar: الحجز ونظام التسليم (Reservation & Delivery System)): These settings control how a document reserves stock for its lines and how it participates in the delivery system — the system table that tracks an order through reservation, loading, and final delivery. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Pricing, Taxes & Discounts Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-pricing-taxes-discounts.html) (ar: إعدادات الأسعار والضرائب والخصومات (Pricing, Taxes & Discounts)): This tab controls how unit prices, discounts, and taxes are calculated on documents created under the term — whether they are forced from price lists, recalculated on save, locked after a from-document, or excluded from item cost. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Accounting Effects Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-accounting-effects.html) (ar: إعدادات التأثيرات المحاسبية (Accounting Effects)): Supply Chain documents that carry accounting effects post to the general ledger through configurable debit and credit account sides. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Generation & Dimensions Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-generation-and-dimensions.html) (ar: إعدادات التوليد والمحددات (Generation & Dimensions)): This page covers two related areas of the supply-chain Document Term: how a document automatically generates downstream documents (on commit, or auto/async on save), and how the document's accounting dimensions (محددات: branch, sector, department... - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Document-Specific Options](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/supplychain/document-terms/doc-term-document-specific.html) (ar: خيارات خاصة بأنواع المستندات (Document-Specific)): Most term-config options are shared across document types and are covered on the other pages (General, From-Document, Quantity Tracking, Reservation & Delivery, Pricing/Taxes/Discounts, Sub-Item). - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

### Freight Management

- [Freight Management](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/) (ar: إدارة الشحن): Welcome to the Freight Management module of Nama ERP — the module built specifically for shipping, forwarding, customs-clearance, postal, and logistics companies, where the "goods" you sell aren't items on a shelf but a service...
- [Freight Master Files](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-master-files.html) (ar: الملفات الأساسية لإدارة الشحن): The Freight master files: service items and their flags, containers with their types and sizes, vessels, ports and sailing schedules, commodities, countries, locations, bill of lading types and units. - entities: FRMServiceItem, FRMContainer, FRMContainerType, FRMContainerSize, FRMOceanVessel, ShippingPort, FRMSailingSchedule, FRMCommodity, FRMBillOfLadingType, FRMUOM, FRMCountry, FRMLocation - screens (ar): بند خدمة, حاوية, نوع حاوية, حجم حاوية, سفينة بحرية, ميناء شحن, جدول إبحار, سلعة, نوع بوليصة شحن, وحدة شحن, دولة, موقع شحن
- [Operation Orders](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/operation-orders.html) (ar: أوامر التشغيل (Operation Orders)): The operation order is the heart of the Freight Management module. - entities: FRMOperationOrder, FRMOOStatus, FRMOODelivery, FRMOOReceipt, FRMOOTransfer - screens (ar): أمر تشغيل, حالة أمر تشغيل, مستند تسليم أمر تشغيل, مستند استلام أمر تشغيل, مستند نقل أمر تشغيل - menu: Freight Management System → Documents → FRM Operation Order
- [Bills of Lading](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/bills-of-lading.html) (ar: بوالص الشحن (Bills of Lading)): The bill of lading is the official shipping document that proves the carrier's receipt of the goods and the terms of their carriage and delivery. - entities: FRMBillOfLading - screens (ar): بوليصة شحن - menu: Freight Management System → Documents → Bill of Lading
- [Price Lists & Markups](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-pricing.html) (ar: قوائم الأسعار والهوامش): The freight Service Purchase Price List and Service Sales Price List: their fields and service-type lines, markups, how operation orders pick up prices, and how a sale is linked to its cost. - entities: FRMSalesPriceList, FRMPurchasePriceList, FRMEditPurchasePriceList - screens (ar): قائمة أسعار مبيعات خدمات, قائمة أسعار شراء خدمات, تعديل قائمة أسعار مشتريات خدمة
- [From Supplier Rates to Customer Quotations](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-price-list-workflow.html) (ar: من أسعار الموردين إلى عروض أسعار العملاء): Working with freight price lists: the price list elements behind each line, loading supplier rates, turning them into a customer quotation, re-pricing it, and bulk changes with Edit Purchase Price List. - entities: FRMPurchasePriceList, FRMPPriceListElement, FRMSalesPriceList, FRMSPriceListElement, FRMEditPurchasePriceList - screens (ar): قائمة أسعار شراء خدمات, عنصر قوائم أسعار شراء, قائمة أسعار مبيعات خدمات, عنصر قوائم أسعار بيع, تعديل قائمة أسعار مشتريات خدمة
- [Invoices & Returns](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-invoicing.html) (ar: الفواتير والمرتجعات): Freight sales and purchase documents: the Sales Order, Sales Invoice and Sales Return, the Purchase Invoice and Purchase Return, how they link to the operation order, and their term configuration and accounting effect. - entities: FRMSalesInvoice, FRMPurchaseInvoice, FRMSalesOrder, FRMSalesReturn, FRMPurchaseReturn - screens (ar): فاتورة مبيعات خدمة, فاتورة مشتريات خدمة, أمر بيع خدمة, مردود مبيعات خدمة, مردود مشتريات خدمة
- [Storage Locations](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-storage-locations.html) (ar: مواقع التخزين (Storage Locations)): Freight storage locations: setting up FRM Location with capacity, section, type and class, the space an operation order needs, and the receipt, transfer and delivery documents that move cargo. - entities: FRMLocation, FRMLocationSection, FRMLocationClass, FRMLocationType, FRMOOReceipt, FRMOOTransfer, FRMOODelivery, FRMOOStatus - screens (ar): موقع شحن, قسم موقع شحن, فئة موقع شحن, نوع موقع شحن, مستند استلام أمر تشغيل, مستند نقل أمر تشغيل, مستند تسليم أمر تشغيل, حالة أمر تشغيل
- [E-Invoicing in the Freight Module](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-einvoicing.html) (ar: التعامل مع الفاتورة الإلكترونية في وحدة الشحن): The freight module's invoices plug into Nama ERP's e-invoicing framework exactly like ordinary sales invoices — they are Tax Authority Documents sent to the relevant authority (ZATCA in Saudi Arabia, the Egyptian Tax Authority, the UAE system…). - entities: FRMSalesInvoice, FRMServiceItem - screens (ar): فاتورة مبيعات خدمة, بند خدمة
- [International Postal System (IPS) — Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/ips-postal-intro.html) (ar: نظام البريد الدولي (IPS) — نظرة عامة): Alongside freight and logistics, the Freight Management module includes a complete system for running International Postal System (IPS) operations. - entities: IPSMailClass, IPSMailCategory, IPSMailSubclass, IPSMailCondition, IPSParcelStatus, IPSDeliveryAndReceiptArea, IPSMailRetentionReason, IPSNonDeliveryReason, IPSNonDeliveryMeasure, IPSEvent - screens (ar): فئة بريد, تصنيف البريد, نوع البريد, حالة البريد, حالة الطرد, مكان تسليم واستلام, سبب تحقق البريد, سبب عدم التوصيل, إجراء عدم التسليم
- [Mail Items](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/ips-mail-items.html) (ar: المواد البريدية): After the inbound receptacles are opened, the mail item becomes the focus of the work: it's recorded, transferred between offices, adjusted, stock-taken, and sorted for delivery. - entities: IPSMailItemManifest, IPSPostalParcelsSort, IPSMailItemTransfer, IPSMailItemAdjustment, IPSMailItemStockTaking, IPSMailRetentionDocument - screens (ar): مستند تجميع مواد, فرز الطرد توصيل / تخزين, سند تحويل بين المكاتب, سند تسوية شحنة, سند تفريغ المخزن للجرد وإعادة التخزين, مذكرة تحقيق بريد
- [Receptacles](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/ips-receptacles.html) (ar: الأكياس البريدية (Receptacles)): A receptacle is the transport container that gathers several mail items for movement between offices — a sealed bag or box. - entities: IPSReceptaclesReceipt, IPSManifestForCustody, IPSTransferReceptacles - screens (ar): استلام الكيس, منافيست للجمرك, مستند إرسال الاكياس جدول الطريق
- [Delivery Service](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/ips-delivery.html) (ar: خدمة التوصيل (Delivery)): The final stage in a mail item's journey: delivering it to the customer and collecting the service value and any customs fees. - entities: IPSDeliveryRequest, IPSDeliveryInvoice, IPSDeliveryServiceItem, IPSDeliveryServicePrice - screens (ar): طلب توصيل, فاتورة توصيل, بند خدمة توصيل, ملف أسعار خدمة توصيل
- [IPS Integration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/ips-integration.html) (ar: التكامل مع نظام IPS (IPS Integration)): Connecting the freight module's postal documents to the IPS international postal system: the IPS settings, look-ups that fill receptacle and mail item lines, and the events reported on save. - entities: IPSEvent, IPSReceptaclesReceipt, IPSTransferReceptacles, IPSMailItemManifest, IPSManifestForCustody, IPSMailRetentionDocument, IPSMailItemTransfer, IPSMailItemStockTaking, IPSMailItemAdjustment, IPSPostalParcelsSort - screens (ar): استلام الكيس, مستند إرسال الاكياس جدول الطريق, مستند تجميع مواد, منافيست للجمرك, مذكرة تحقيق بريد, سند تحويل بين المكاتب, سند تفريغ المخزن للجرد وإعادة التخزين, سند تسوية شحنة, فرز الطرد توصيل / تخزين
- [Freight Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات وحدة الشحن (Freight Configuration)): The freight module keeps a short list of module-wide settings in one screen: which service item to fall back on when a price-list line carries none, how storage locations are suggested and checked... - menu: Freight Management System → Settings → Freight Management System Settings
- [Freight Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/freight/freight-document-terms.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات الشحن (Freight Document Terms)): Every freight and postal document is saved under a document term, and the term is where the document's behaviour is decided: which accounts it books to, which status it stamps on the operation order, which postal event it reports... - entities: DocumentTerm, FRMSalesInvoice, FRMSalesReturn, FRMSalesOrder, FRMPurchaseInvoice, FRMPurchaseReturn, FRMOperationOrder, FRMOOReceipt, FRMOOTransfer, FRMOODelivery, IPSDeliveryRequest, IPSDeliveryInvoice, IPSMailItemManifest, IPSMailItemTransfer, IPSMailItemStockTaking, IPSMailItemAdjustment, IPSManifestForCustody, IPSMailRetentionDocument, IPSPostalParcelsSort, IPSReceptaclesReceipt, IPSTransferReceptacles - screens (ar): توجيه مستند, فاتورة مبيعات خدمة, مردود مبيعات خدمة, أمر بيع خدمة, فاتورة مشتريات خدمة, مردود مشتريات خدمة, أمر تشغيل, مستند استلام أمر تشغيل, مستند نقل أمر تشغيل, مستند تسليم أمر تشغيل, طلب توصيل, فاتورة توصيل, مستند تجميع مواد, سند تحويل بين المكاتب, سند تفريغ المخزن للجرد وإعادة التخزين, سند تسوية شحنة, منافيست للجمرك, مذكرة تحقيق بريد, فرز الطرد توصيل / تخزين, استلام الكيس, مستند إرسال الاكياس جدول الطريق - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

### Hospital Management System

- [Hospital Management System](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/) (ar: نظام إدارة المستشفيات): Welcome to the Hospital Management module of Nama ERP — the module that runs the full patient lifecycle: from the moment a patient is registered, through admission and a bed assignment, then consultations, lab tests, radiology and surgeries...
- [Hospital Management System Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات نظام إدارة المستشفيات): The hospital module has one settings record, and it is small: seventeen options on a single tab. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Hospital Management System → Settings → Hospital Management System Settings
- [Hospital Structure & Rooms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-facility.html) (ar: هيكل المستشفى والغرف): Before you admit your first patient, you need to map your building inside the system: which buildings you have, their floors and sections, which rooms and beds they hold, and which clinics operate. - entities: HMSRoom, HMSRoomClassification, HMSBed, HMSSection, HMSBuilding, HMSFloor, HMSClinic, HMSRoomDegree - screens (ar): غرفة مستشفى, تصنيف غرفة, سرير, قسم طبى, مبنى مستشفى, طابق مستشفى, عيادة, درجة الغرفة - menu: Hospital Management System → Hospital Structure → HMS Room
- [Medical Master Files](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-medical-master-files.html) (ar: الملفات الطبية الأساسية): Having mapped the building, we now define the staff and medical concepts that the documents work with every day: doctors, specialties, diseases, medical services, analyzers, feeding, and patient classes. - entities: HMSDoctor, HMSMedicalService, HMSMedicalSpecialty, HMSMedServiceCategory, HMSDisease, HMSAntibiotic, HMSMedicalDevice, HMSFeedingType, HMSPatientClass, HMSDocumentCategory, HMSProcedureType - screens (ar): طبيب, الخدمة الطبية, تخصص طبي, تصنيف خدمات طبية, مرض, مضاد حيوى, جهاز تحليل, نوع تغذية, فئة مريض, تصنيف طبى, نوع الإجراء - menu: Hospital Management System → Master Files → Doctor
- [Medical Service Catalog](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-service-catalog.html) (ar: كتالوج الخدمات الطبية): Alongside general medical services, the hospital keeps specialized catalogs for each kind of clinical activity: lab tests, radiology, physiotherapy, and surgeries. - entities: HMSLabTestType, HMSRadiologyType, HMSSurgeryType, HMSPhysicalTherapyType, HMSSurgeryPackage, HMSPackageItem, HMSLabTestCategory, HMSRadiologyCategory, HMSPhyTherapyCategory, HMSSurgeryClassification, HMSTest, HMSTestTube, HMSTestTubeColor - screens (ar): نوع تحليل طبي, نوع أشعة, نوع عملية جراحية, نوع العلاج الطبيعى, اتفاق عملية, بند اتفاق عملية, تصنيف تحليل طبى, تصنيف أشعة, تصنيف علاج طبيعى, تصنيف عملية جراحية, اختبار, أنبوبة اختبار, لون أنبوبة الإختبار - menu: Hospital Management System → Laboratory Tests → Laboratory Test Type
- [Medical Insurance & Approvals](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-insurance.html) (ar: التأمين الطبي والموافقات): Insurance is what makes hospital billing different: the patient rarely pays the whole bill. - entities: InsuranceCompanyApproval, HMSInsuranceCompany, HMSInsuranceClass, HMSInsuranceCompanyClass - screens (ar): موافقة شركة تأمين, شركة تأمين طبى, فئة تأمين, فئة شركة تأمين طبى - menu: Hospital Management System → Master Files → Insurance Company Approval
- [Pricing, Costing & Discounts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hms/hms-pricing.html) (ar: الأسعار والتكاليف والخصومات): HMS pricing screens: Medical Sales Price List, Medical Cost List, Medical Discount, the overhead items, lists and Actual Overhead Calculation, and Change Patient Price Plan. - entities: HMSSalesPriceList, HMSCostList, HMSDiscount, HMSOverheadItem, HMSOverheadList, HMSActualOverheadCalculation, HMSChangePatientPricePlan - screens (ar): قائمة أسعار طبية, قائمة تكاليف طبية, خصم طبى, بند تكاليف طبية غير مباشرة, قائمة تكاليف طبية غير مباشرة, سند حساب التكلفة الطبية الغير مباشرة الفعلية, تغيير خطة أسعار مريض - menu: Hospital Management System → Master Files → Medical Sales Price List

### Manufacturing

- [Manufacturing](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/) (ar: التصنيع): Manufacturing is where raw materials become finished goods — and where Nama ERP helps you plan that transformation, record what actually happened on the shop floor, and put a real cost on every unit you produce.
