- [Bill of Materials: The Recipe for a Product](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/manufacturing-bom.html) (ar: مكونات المنتج (BOM): وصفة تصنيع المنتج): Nothing else in the manufacturing module works until the system knows what a product is made of. - entities: BOM - screens (ar): مكونات منتج - menu: Manufacturing → Master Files → BOM - licence: manufacturing
- [Routings: The Steps a Product Goes Through](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/manufacturing-routing.html) (ar: مسارات التشغيل: الخطوات التي يمر بها المنتج): A bill of materials tells you what a product is made of. - entities: Routing - screens (ar): عملية تشغيل - menu: Manufacturing → Master Files → Routing - licence: manufacturing
- [Work Centers and Standard Operations](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/manufacturing-work-centers.html) (ar: صالات الإنتاج والعمليات القياسية): How to set up Work Centers and Standard Operations, the master files that hold the resources, rates, tolerances and molds that routings point to. - entities: WorkCenter, StandardOperation - screens (ar): صالة إنتاج, عملية قياسية - licence: manufacturing
- [Production Order Requests: Asking for Something to Be Made](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/production-order-request.html) (ar: طلبات أوامر الإنتاج: أن تطلب تصنيع شيء): In a small workshop the person who decides what to make is the person who makes it, and a production order raised directly is the whole story. - entities: ProductionOrderRequest - screens (ar): طلب أمر إنتاج - menu: Manufacturing → Documents → Production Order Request - licence: manufacturing
- [Production Orders: Planning What to Make](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/production-orders.html) (ar: أوامر الإنتاج (Production Orders): التخطيط لما سيتم تصنيعه): A Production Order (أمر إنتاج) is your formal instruction to the factory: "Make this product, in this quantity, by this date." - entities: ProductionOrder, AggregatedProductionOrder - screens (ar): أمر إنتاج, سند أوامر الإنتاج المجمعة - menu: Manufacturing → Documents → Production Order - licence: manufacturing
- [Production Execution: Recording What Actually Happens](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/production-execution.html) (ar: تنفيذ الإنتاج (Production Execution): تسجيل ما يحدث فعلاً): You've created a production order - that's your plan. - entities: ProductionExecution - screens (ar): تنفيذ إنتاج - menu: Manufacturing → Documents → Production Execution - licence: manufacturing
- [Issuing and Returning Raw Materials](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/raw-material-issue.html) (ar: صرف المواد الخام وإرتجاعها): The Raw Materials Issue, Raw Materials Return and Raw Material Change documents that move material to and from a production order: header, lot collection, details grid and what happens on save. - entities: RawMaterialIssue, RawMaterialReturn, RawMaterialChangeDoc - screens (ar): صرف مواد خام, إرتجاع مواد خام, تغيير خامة - menu: Manufacturing → Documents → Raw Materials Issue - licence: manufacturing
- [Resource Vouchers: Charging Machine and Labour Time](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/manufacturing/manufacturing-resource-voucher.html) (ar: سندات الموارد: تحميل زمن الماكينات والعمالة): The Resource Voucher, which charges machine, labour and other resource time to a production order: when it is needed beyond auto-charged operations, its header, details grid and where the cost goes. - entities: ResourceVoucher - screens (ar): سند موارد - menu: Manufacturing → Documents → Resource Voucher - licence: manufacturing

#### Payroll

- [Vacations & Leaves](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/vacations/) (ar: الأجازات)
- [Vacation Types & Balances](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/vacations/vacation-types-and-balances.html) (ar: أنواع وأرصدة الأجازات): The Vacation Type master file and its accrual, consumption and carry-forward rules, the Vacation Balance Range File for seniority-based entitlement, and the Opening Vacation Balance Document. - entities: VacationType, VacationBalanceRange, OpeningVacationBalanceDoc - screens (ar): نوع الأجازة, ملف أرصدة الأجازات (بناءا على الخبرات), سند إدخال رصيد أجازة إفتتاحية
- [Vacation Documents](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/vacations/vacation-documents.html) (ar: مستندات الأجازات): This page covers the screens that actually put an employee on leave: the Vacation Request (طلب أجازة) and Vacation Document (سند أجازة) pair, the Vacation Plan Document (مستند خطة أجازة) used to schedule leave ahead of time... - entities: VacationDocument, VacationRequest, VacationPlanDocument, MultiEmpVacation, AggregatedVacationDocument - screens (ar): سند أجازة, طلب أجازة, مستند خطة أجازة, سند أجازة مجمع لأكثر من موظف, سند أجازه مجمع
- [Vacation Compensation & Transfer](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/vacations/vacation-compensation-and-transfer.html) (ar: تعويض ونقل الأجازات): The Vacation Compensation, Vacation Transfer, Vacation Changing and Holidays And Rest Days Balance Compensation documents: cashing out, carrying forward, correcting and earning vacation balance. - entities: VacationCompensation, VacationTransferDocument, VacationChangingDocument, HolidaysRestBalanceDoc - screens (ar): سند صرف بدل أجازة, سند ترحيل أجازات, سند تعديل رصيد أجازة, بدل أرصده راحات أسبوعية و عطلات رسمية
- [Change Employee State](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/vacations/change-employee-state.html) (ar: تغيير حالة الموظف): Every employee carries one working state at a time — Working, In Vacation, Suspended, Resigned, Dismissed, Pension, and a set of open-ended "Other" states a company can repurpose for its own needs. - entities: ChangeEmployeeState - screens (ar): تغير حالة موظف - menu: Payroll → Vacations → ChangeEmployeeState

#### Loans & Installments

- [Loans & Installments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/loans/) (ar: السلف والأقساط)
- [Loan Types](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/loans/hr-loan-types.html) (ar: أنواع السلف): Every loan or salary advance in Nama starts from a Loan Type (نوع السلفة) — a master file that defines what an employee can borrow: the default and allowed range for the amount, the default and allowed range for the number of installments... - entities: HRLoanType - screens (ar): نوع السلفة - menu: Payroll → Loans / Installments → Loan Type
- [Loan Documents & Payments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/loans/hr-loan-documents.html) (ar: مستندات وسداد السلف): This page covers the three screens that turn a loan from a request into money in an employee's pocket, and eventually back out again: the Loan Request (طلب سلفة) and Loan Document (سند سلفة) pair... - entities: HRLoanDocument, HRLoanRequest, HRLoanPaymentDocument - screens (ar): سند سلفة, طلب سلفة, سند سداد سلفة
- [Loan Adjustments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/loans/hr-loan-adjustments.html) (ar: تسويات السلف): Once a Loan Document is running, three separate screens change it without touching the original disbursement: writing part of the balance off, moving installments around in time, and pausing (or resuming) the whole loan. - entities: HRLoanReliefDocument, HRLoanInstallReschedule, HRLoanDisableDocument - screens (ar): سند أعفاء سلفة, سند إعاده جدوله اقساط سلفه, سند تعطيل سلفة

#### Rewards, Penalties & Suspension

- [Rewards, Penalties & Suspension](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/discipline/) (ar: المكافآت والجزاءات والإيقاف)
- [Rewards & Penalties](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/discipline/rewards-and-penalties.html) (ar: المكافآت والجزاءات): The Reward / Penalty catalog and the (Reward / Penalty) Document in Payroll: defining one-off bonuses and deductions, applying one to an employee on a date, and how it reaches the salary or the ledger. - entities: RewardAndPenaltieDocument, RewardAndPenalty - screens (ar): سند مكافأة/جزاء, نوع مكافأة / جزاء
- [Suspension](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/discipline/hr-suspension.html) (ar: إيقاف الموظف عن العمل): A Suspension Document (إيقاف عن العمل) records that an employee was suspended from work for a stretch of days — and, depending on why, whether that stretch is paid or not. - entities: SuspensionDocument - screens (ar): إيقاف عن العمل - menu: Payroll → Reward / Penalty → Suspension Document

#### Performance

- [Performance](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/performance/) (ar: تقييم الأداء)
- [Performance Indicators](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/performance/performance-indicators.html) (ar: مؤشرات الأداء (Performance Indicators)): Performance Indicator, Manual Measure, Performance Measure and System Indicator Approval: defining a measured value, its manual, system or script sources, the 73 system indicators, and how it reaches the salary. - entities: PerformanceIndicator, PerformanceMeasure, ManualMeasures, SysIndicatorApproval - screens (ar): مؤشر الأداء, قيمة مؤشر أداء, قيم المؤشرات اليدوية, موافقة على مؤشر أداء نظامى
- [Employee Evaluation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/performance/employee-evaluation.html) (ar: تقييم الموظف (Employee Evaluation)): Where Performance Indicators measure things that can be counted automatically — hours, occurrences, sales — an Employee Evaluation (تقييم موظف) is for the parts of performance that need a human judgment: how well someone communicates... - entities: EmployeeEvaluation, EmployeeEvaluationReq, EvaluationElement, EvaluationElementsGroup - screens (ar): تقييم موظف, طلب تقييم موظف, عنصر تقييم, مجموعة نقاط تقييم - menu: Human Resources → Recruitment → Employee Evaluation

#### Recruitment

- [Recruitment](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/recruitment/) (ar: التوظيف)
- [Vacancies & Candidates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/recruitment/vacancies-and-candidates.html) (ar: الوظائف الشاغرة والمرشحون (Vacancies & Candidates)): Recruitment screens: HR Vacancy Type as a reusable job profile, HR Vacancy for an actual opening, HR Candidate for registering applicants, and HR Test and HR Test Result. - entities: HRVacancy, HRVacancyType, HRCandidate, HRTest, HRTestResult - screens (ar): فرصة عمل, نوع فرصة عمل, متقدم للعمل, إختبار, نتائج الإختبار
- [Job Offers & Tests](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/recruitment/job-offers-and-tests.html) (ar: عروض العمل والاختبارات (Job Offers & Tests)): A candidate who clears interviews and testing doesn't just get hired on a handshake — Nama puts the proposed terms of employment into their own document first, so the job title, salary package... - entities: JobOffer, CandidateJobOffer, AggregatedJobOffer, HRTest, HRTestResult - screens (ar): عرض وظيفي, عرض وظيفي لمتقدم للعمل, عرض وظيفي مجمع, إختبار, نتائج الإختبار
- [Work Starting](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/recruitment/work-starting.html) (ar: بدء العمل): The Work Starting Request and Work Starting Document: recording an employee's first day back after hiring, a vacation or a suspension, what processing does, and the Aggregated Vacation Work Starting Document. - entities: WorkStartingDocument, WorkStartingRequest, AggregatedVacationStartingDoc - screens (ar): سند مباشرة عمل, طلب مباشرة عمل, سند مباشرة عمل أجازة مجمعة - menu: Payroll → Recruitment → Work Starting Document
- [Employee Relocation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/recruitment/employee-relocation.html) (ar: نقل الموظف): People and their records change after they're hired: a branch gets restructured and someone's whole department moves, an employee needs a raise or a new job title, a passport gets renewed... - entities: EmployeeRelocate, EmployeeRelocateRequest, UpdateEmployeeInfo, AggrUpdateEmpInfo, WorkPlaceUpdate - screens (ar): سند نقل موظف, طلب نقل موظف, تحديث بيانات الموظف, سند تحديث بيانات موظف مجمع, تحديث مكان العمل

#### Training

- [Training](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/training/) (ar: التدريب)
- [Training Courses & Plans](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/training/training-courses-and-plans.html) (ar: الدورات وخطط التدريب): Before anyone can be trained, there has to be something to train them in. - entities: TrainingCourse, TrainingPlan, CourseEnrollment, EndTrainingCourse - screens (ar): دورة تدريبية, خطة تدريب, تسجيل المتدربين بدورة, إنهاء دورة تدريبية
- [Course Evaluation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/training/hr-course-evaluation.html) (ar: تقييم الدورة التدريبية (Course Evaluation)): Employee Evaluation rates ongoing staff performance against a catalog of scored criteria. - entities: CourseEvaluation, EvaluationElement - screens (ar): تقييم دورة تدريبية, عنصر تقييم - menu: Human Resources → Training → Course Evaluation

#### Provisions & End of Service

- [Provisions & End of Service](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/end-of-service/) (ar: المخصصات وإنهاء الخدمة)
- [HR Provisions (End-of-Service & Vacation Accrual)](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/end-of-service/hr-provisions.html) (ar: مخصصات الموظفين (نهاية الخدمة ورصيد الأجازات)): End-of-service and vacation accrual provisions: the salary component flags that feed them, opening a provision per employee, recalculating it every period, its accounting effect and bulk recalculation. - entities: EmployeeProvisionsRecalc, EmployeeProvisionsOpening, AggrEmpProvisionsRecalc - screens (ar): سند إعادة احتساب مخصصات موظف, سند إفتتاحي مخصصات موظف, سند إعادة احتساب مخصصات موظف مجمع
- [Firing & Termination](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/end-of-service/firing-and-termination.html) (ar: إنهاء الخدمة والتصفية): Ending employment in HR: the Firing Request and Firing Document, generating the final settlement, Termination Reasons with their end-of-service gratuity rules, and aggregated firing for many employees. - entities: FiringDocument, FiringRequest, TerminationReason, AggFiringDocument, AggFiringRequest - screens (ar): سند إنهاء الخدمة, طلب إنهاء الخدمة, سبب نهاية الخدمة, سند إنهاء خدمة مجمع, طلب إنهاء خدمة مجمعة
- [Dues Liquidation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/end-of-service/dues-liquidation.html) (ar: تصفية المستحقات (Dues Liquidation)): The Dues Liquidation Document for an employee's final settlement: gratuity, unused vacation, unpaid salary, loan balances and manual adjustments, how the figures are built, its accounting effect and bulk settlement. - entities: DuesLiquidationDoc, DuesLiquidationComponent, AggrDuesLiquidationDoc - screens (ar): مستند تصفية مستحقات, مكون التصفية, سند تصفية مستحقات مجمعة - menu: Payroll → Dues Liquidation and Firing → Dues Liquidation Document
- [Evacuation Approval](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/end-of-service/evacuation-approval.html) (ar: الموافقة على إخلاء الطرف (Evacuation Approval)): The departmental clearance before a settlement or long leave: Evacuation Approval Settings as the step template, the Evacuation Party Document per employee, and each step's Evacuation Approval Document. - entities: EvacuationPartyDocument, EvacuationApprovalSettings, EvacuationApprovalDocument - screens (ar): سند إخلاء طرف, إعدادات الموافقة على سند إخلاء طرف, الموافقة على إخلاء طرف

#### Government Relations

- [Government Relations](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/) (ar: العلاقات الحكومية)
- [Government Relations Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/government-relations-overview.html) (ar: نظرة عامة على العلاقات الحكومية (Government Relations Overview)): Overview of the Gulf government relations documents (residency, visas, GOSI): their shared cycle, the Transaction Type fee catalogue, the Definition Letter, and the Payment Request for government fees. - entities: HOTransactionType, HODefinitionLetter, HOPaymentRequest - screens (ar): نوع معاملة, خطاب تعريف موظف, طلب سداد مدفوعات
- [HR Visas](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/hr-visas.html) (ar: التأشيرات (HR Visas)): An expatriate employee in the Gulf cannot simply leave the country and come back, or bring family over to visit, without a government visa each time — and every one of those visas has an issue date, a duration and an expiry that HR has to track. - entities: HOExitReEntryVisaReq, AggrHOExitReEntryVisaReq, HOExtendingVisaReq, HOFinalExitVisaReq, HOFamilyVisitVisaRequest, HOPassportDeliveringReq - screens (ar): طلب تأشيرة خروج وعودة, طلب تأشيرة خروج وعودة مجمع, طلب تمديد تاشيرة الخروج والعودة, طلب تاشيرة خروج نهائي, طلب زيارة عائليه, طلب استلام جواز سفر
- [Residence Renewal](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/residence-renewal.html) (ar: تجديد الإقامة (Residence Renewal)): Of every deadline the PRO desk tracks, the Iqama (residency permit) is the one that cannot slip — an expired residency stops an employee from working, travelling or even opening a bank account. - entities: ResidenceRenewReq, AggrResidenceRenewReq - screens (ar): طلب تجديد إقامة, طلب تجديد إقامة مجمع - menu: Human Resources → ADMINISTRATIVE TRANSACTIONS → Residence Renew Request
- [Visa Pool](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/visa-pool.html) (ar: مجمع التأشيرات (Visa Pool)): Before a single overseas hire can travel, the company needs a work visa allocated to them — and in Saudi / Gulf recruiting, those visas are not requested one at a time. - entities: HRIssuedVisas, HRVisasDelegation, HRVisaHandling - screens (ar): تأشيرات صادرة, تفويض تاشيرة, منح تأشيرة
- [Social Insurance & Sponsorship](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/social-insurance-and-sponsorship.html) (ar: التأمينات الاجتماعية والكفالة): Two of the most sensitive government touch-points for an expatriate workforce are the GOSI social insurance register and the sponsorship (Kafala) relationship. - entities: HOEmpSocialInsuranceAdd, HOEmpSocialInsuranceRemove, HOSponsorshipTransferDoc, AggrHOSponsorshipTransferDoc - screens (ar): سند إضافة موظفين للتأمينات الإجتماعية, سند حذف موظفين من التأمينات الإجتماعية, طلب نقل كفالة موظف, طلب نقل كفالة مجمع
- [Government Penalties](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/government-relations/government-penalties.html) (ar: الجزاءات الحكومية): Alongside the visa and fee work, the government-relations desk maintains the company's disciplinary code — the internal list of workplace violations and the penalties attached to them — and issues the documents that apply a penalty to an employee. - entities: HOViolationItem, HOViolationList, HOPenaltyDocument, HOPenaltyRequest - screens (ar): بند مخالفة, مادة لائحة إدارية, سند مخالفة, طلب مخالفة

#### Health Insurance

- [Health Insurance](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/health-insurance/) (ar: التأمين الصحي)
- [Employee Health Insurance](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/hr/health-insurance/employee-health-insurance.html) (ar: التأمين الصحي للموظف (Employee Health Insurance)): In the Gulf, private health insurance is not optional paperwork — it is a government-mandated benefit, and covering the wrong category, missing a spouse, or letting a policy lapse creates real liability. - entities: EmployeeHealthInsurance, HealthInsuranceOffer, HealthInsuranceClaimDoc, HealthInsuranceUpgrade, HealthInsuranceCredence, EmpHealthInsurDelete - screens (ar): سند إضافة موظف للتأمين, عرض تأمين  مقدم من شركة, سند تعويض طبي, سند ترقية تأمين, سند تعميد شركة تأمين, سند حذف تأمين موظف

### Point of Sale

- [Point of Sale](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/) (ar: نقاط البيع): Landing page for Nama POS, the offline-first desktop register with the Captain Order waiter app: how the guide is organised, from installing a register and selling to server-side setup.
- [Nama POS — Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-overview.html) (ar: نقاط البيع (Nama POS) — نظرة عامة): Overview of Nama POS: the offline-first desktop register, the Captain Order mobile app, the central ERP side where registers and permissions are set up, and what can be done at the register.
- [Installing Nama POS on a New Register and Connecting It to the Server](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-installation.html) (ar: تنزيل نقاط البيع على ماكينة جديدة وربطها بالخادم الرئيسي): Nama POS is a desktop application that runs right on the cash register and keeps its own local database, so it can keep selling even when the connection to the central server drops.
- [Getting Started at the Register](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-getting-started.html) (ar: البداية على الماكينة): This page walks through the everyday basics: starting the application, signing in, finding your way around the menu, locking the screen when you step away, and switching language or theme. - entities: POSSecurityProfile, NamaPOSShortcuts - screens (ar): صلاحيات نقاط البيع, اختصارات نقطة البيع
- [The Sales Invoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-sales-invoice.html) (ar: فاتورة المبيعات): The sales screen is where a cashier spends almost the whole day. - entities: NamaPOSSalesInvoice - screens (ar): فاتورة مبيعات نقاط البيع - menu: Point of sale → Documents → POS Sales Invoice
- [Payment & Tender](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-payment-and-tender.html) (ar: الدفع والتحصيل): Pressing F5 on a finished invoice opens the tender screen — the moment of truth where money changes hands. - entities: NamaPOSSalesInvoice - screens (ar): فاتورة مبيعات نقاط البيع
- [Returns & Replacements](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-returns-and-replacements.html) (ar: المرتجعات والإحلال): POS sales returns (full or partial, with or without the original invoice, return reasons and wear deductions), replacements, credit notes and discount coupons, with the messages a cashier may see. - entities: NamaPOSSalesReturn, NamaPOSSalesReplacement, NamaPOSCreditNote - screens (ar): مردود نقاط البيع, إستبدال مبيعات نقاط البيع, إشعار دائن نقاط البيع
- [Shifts & Cash](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-shifts-and-cash.html) (ar: الورديات والنقدية): A shift is one work session on a register: it opens when a cashier starts, and closes when they count down the drawer and hand over. - entities: POSShiftOpening, POSShiftClosing, POSReceiptFromRegister, POSPaymentToRegister - screens (ar): فتح ورديه, غلق وردية, مقبوض نقاط البيع, مصروف نقاط البيع
- [Tables, Reservations & Captain Order](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-tables-and-restaurant.html) (ar: الطاولات والحجوزات وكابتن أوردر): Restaurants and cafés sell differently from a shop counter: orders belong to tables, waiters take them away from the till, and some are booked in advance. - entities: NamaPOSHall, NamaPOSTable, NamaPOSOrderReservation, NamaPOSCancelReservation - screens (ar): صالة نقاط البيع, طاولة نقاط البيع, سند حجز اوردر نقاط بيع, سند إلغاء حجز اوردر نقاط بيع
- [Self-Checkout Kiosk](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-self-checkout-kiosk.html) (ar: كشك الدفع الذاتي (Self-Checkout Kiosk)): A self-checkout kiosk lets shoppers scan their own items and pay by card without a cashier.
- [Item Add-ons](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-item-addons.html) (ar: إضافات الأصناف): Item add-ons at the POS: the POS Item Additional Items setup that offers up to ten groups of choices when an item is added, with single or multiple, required and default choices. - entities: NamaPosItemAdditionalItems - screens (ar): الأصناف الإضافية للصنف في نقاط البيع - menu: Point of sale → Settings → POS Item Additional Items
- [Inventory Operations at the Register](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-inventory-operations.html) (ar: العمليات المخزنية على الماكينة): The stock documents a shop user creates at the register: stock receipt, stock transfer request, stock taking, and scrap and shortfalls documents for damaged or missing stock. - entities: NamaPOSStockReceipt, NamaPOSStockTransferReq, NamaPOSStockTakingDetails, NamaPOSScrapDoc, NamaPOSShortfallsDoc - screens (ar): توريد نقاط البيع, طلب تحويل مخزني نقاط البيع, لجنة جرد نقط بيع, مستند الهوالك, مستند النواقص
- [Reports & Tools](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-reports-and-tools.html) (ar: التقارير والأدوات): Beyond selling, the register carries a handful of everyday tools: running reports, messaging other staff, checking a price without making a sale, and — for supervisors — running maintenance utilities. - entities: NamaPOSInternalMessage - screens (ar): رسالة نقاط بيع داخليه
- [How POS Data Syncs with the Server](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-data-sync.html) (ar: كيف تتزامن بيانات نقاط البيع مع الخادم): This is the idea that makes Nama POS what it is, so it is worth understanding even if you never touch the technical side.

#### Server-Side Setup

- [Server-Side Setup](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/) (ar: الإعداد على الخادم): Landing page for POS server-side setup: the register master file, POS Settings and the supporting screens that control warehouses, numbering, shift closing, accounts and cashier permissions.
- [Setting Up a Register](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-register-setup.html) (ar: إعداد الماكينة (Register)): Every machine that runs Nama POS is described on the server by one Register record (ماكينة). - entities: NamaPOSRegister, NamaPOSHall, NamaPOSTable - screens (ar): صالة نقاط البيع, طاولة نقاط البيع - menu: Point of sale → Register → Register
- [The POS Settings Screen](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-settings-screen.html) (ar: شاشة إعدادات نقاط البيع): POS Settings (إعدادات نقاط البيع) is where the behaviour of every register in the company is decided: how prices are found, what the payment dialog does, which documents a cashier may save without a connection, how sales reach the server. - menu: Point of sale → Settings → POS Settings
- [Numbering POS Documents](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-document-numbering.html) (ar: ترقيم مستندات نقاط البيع): Registers work offline, so they cannot ask the server for the next invoice number the way a screen in the ERP does. - entities: NamaPOSRegister - screens (ar): ماكينة - menu: Point of sale → Register → Register
- [Shift Opening, Closing & Cash-Reset Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-shift-close-settings.html) (ar: إعدادات فتح وغلق الوردية وتصفير النقدية): A cashier opens and closes shifts at the register (see Shifts & Cash). - entities: POSShiftOpening, POSShiftClosing, POSCashDrawer - screens (ar): فتح ورديه, غلق وردية, جرد - menu: Point of sale → Documents → POS Shift Closing
- [POS Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-document-terms.html) (ar: توجيهات مستندات نقاط البيع): How the server picks the book and term for each document a POS register sends, using the register's Books And Terms and term grids, the error term, and what each POS term screen controls. - entities: DocumentTerm, NamaPOSRegister - screens (ar): توجيه مستند, ماكينة
- [POS Security Profiles](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-security-profiles.html) (ar: صلاحيات نقاط البيع (POS Security Profile)): The POS Security Profile screen that controls what a cashier may do at the register: attaching users, checkboxes versus the capabilities grid, supervisor approval instead of refusal, and every permission. - entities: POSSecurityProfile - menu: Point of sale → Settings → POS Security Profile
- [Service Charge, Minimum Charge, Delivery & Return Reasons](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-charges-and-returns-settings.html) (ar: الخدمة السياحية والحد الأدنى للطلب والتوصيل وأسباب الإرجاع): Restaurants and cafés often add something to the bill that is not a dish: a service charge, a delivery fee, or a top-up when a table spends less than the minimum. - entities: POSServiceChargeSettings, PosMinChargeSettings, NamaPOSDeliveryCost, NamaPOSDepreciationReason, NamaPOSReturnReason - screens (ar): إعدادات الخدمة السياحية في نقاط البيع, إعدادات الحد الأدنى للطلب في نقاط البيع, تكاليف خدمة توصيل نقاط البيع, سبب الهالك, سبب الإرجاع
- [What a Register Receives: Items, Barcodes & Sync Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-items-and-sync-settings.html) (ar: ما الذي تستلمه الماكينة: الأصناف والباركود وإعدادات المزامنة): A register only knows what the server sends it. - entities: NaMaPosItemsToSend, NamaPOSItemQtyUpdateConfig, NamaPOSItemBarcodeParser, NamaPOSReadQueuePriorityConfig, NamaPOSInvSavingSettings, NamaPOSExtraFilter, NamaPOSDBUpdateStatement - screens (ar): الأصناف المرسلة لنقاط البيع, إعدادات تحديث كميات الماكينة, مواصفات باركود أصناف نقاط البيع, إعدادات أولوية نقل البيانات للماكينة, إعدادات الحفظ في نقاط البيع, Filters إضافية لنقطة البيع
- [Screen, Keyboard & Device Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-screen-and-device-settings.html) (ar: إعدادات الشاشة ولوحة المفاتيح والأجهزة): The POS settings records that shape what the cashier sees and types: screen layouts, the waiter's phone, keyboard shortcuts, pole display, default values, required fields, phone country codes and payment methods. - entities: NamaPosUISettings, NamaPosMobileUISettings, NamaPOSShortcuts, NamaPosPoleDisplaySpecs, NamaPosDefaultsTemplate, NamaPosRequiredFields, NamaPOSCustomerPhoneCountryCodes, NamaPOSPaymentMethodsSettings, PaymentFromPosSettings - screens (ar): إعدادات واجهة نقاط البيع الجديده, إعدادات واجهة نقاط البيع للموبايل, اختصارات نقطة البيع, خصائص ال Pole Display لنقاط البيع, قالب قيم افتراضيه لنقاط البيع, الحقول المطلوبه لنقاط البيع, أكواد الدول لأرقام عملاء نقاط البيع, إعدادات طرق دفع نقاط البيع, إعدادات دفع من خلال نقاط البيع
- [POS Documents on the Server](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/erp-setup/pos-documents-on-the-server.html) (ar: مستندات نقاط البيع على الخادم): Everything a cashier does at the register — a sale, a refund, a pay-out, a stock count — is saved on the register first and then synced up to Nama ERP as a document (see How POS Data Syncs with the Server). - entities: NamaPOSSalesInvoice, NamaPOSSalesReturn, NamaPOSSalesReplacement, NamaPOSHeldInvoice, NamaPOSReturnPeriodExtension, NamaPOSOrderReservation, NamaPOSCancelReservation, POSPaymentToRegister, POSReceiptFromRegister, NamaPOSStockTransferReq, NamaPOSStockTakingDetails, NamaPOSStockReceipt, NamaPOSShortfallsDoc, NamaPOSScrapDoc, NamaPOSCreditNote, NamaPOSInternalMessage, NamaPOSGenericReference, NamaPOSAggGenericReference - screens (ar): فاتورة مبيعات نقاط البيع, مردود نقاط البيع, إستبدال مبيعات نقاط البيع, فاتورة معلقة, سند تمديد فترة إرجاع مبيعات نقاط البيع, سند حجز اوردر نقاط بيع, سند إلغاء حجز اوردر نقاط بيع, مصروف نقاط البيع, مقبوض نقاط البيع, طلب تحويل مخزني نقاط البيع, لجنة جرد نقط بيع, توريد نقاط البيع, مستند النواقص, مستند الهوالك, إشعار دائن نقاط البيع, رسالة نقاط بيع داخليه, المرجع العام لنقاط البيع, المرجع العام المجمع لنقاط البيع
- [Nama POS — Technical Points of Use Guide](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/nama-pos.html) (ar: دليل استعمال النقاط الفنية في نقاط البيع): Nama ERP is a web-based system, but its Nama POS module includes a dedicated desktop application for Points of Sale (POS), offering both online and offline capabilities: - entities: NamaPosPoleDisplaySpecs - screens (ar): خصائص ال Pole Display لنقاط البيع
- [Free Items in POS: Claim at Scan and Reconciliation at Payment](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-free-items-claim-and-reconciliation.html) (ar: الأصناف المجانية في نقاط البيع: المطالبة بالمسح والتسوية عند الدفع): When you have a promotion of the "buy one item and get another for free" type, the default behavior in the POS is to add the free item to the invoice immediately upon adding the qualifying item. - entities: NamaPOSSalesInvoice - screens (ar): فاتورة مبيعات نقاط البيع
- [Fingerprint Login in Point of Sale](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-fingerprint-login.html) (ar: تسجيل الدخول بالبصمة في نقاط البيع): Fingerprint login at the POS register with a Digital Persona URU4500 reader: installing the driver, enabling it in POS Settings, enrolling fingerprints, logging in and syncing with the server. - entities: UserFingerprint - screens (ar): بصمات المستخدم
- [Point of Sale FAQ](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/pos/pos-faq.html) (ar: أسئلة شائعة حول نقاط البيع): Point of sale questions: the deferred payment method still showing after it is hidden, the repeated payment method error when closing a shift, and building a stock movement report that runs from the POS.

### Real Estate

- [Real Estate](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/) (ar: العقارات): Nama Real Estate is the module for companies whose product is property.
- [Real Estate Module Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/realestate-overview.html) (ar: نظرة عامة على وحدة العقارات): Map of the Real Estate module: the estate tree from project to unit, the four licences, the menu group by group, the core ideas behind it and the cycle from an empty plot to a fully collected contract.
- [Real Estate Module Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/realestate-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات وحدة العقارات): Most of what the Real Estate module does is decided per document book, on the document's term. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - menu: Real Estate and Property → Settings → Real estate Configurations

#### Opening Balances

- [Opening Balances](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/realestate/opening/) (ar: الأرصدة الافتتاحية)

#### Contracting Master Files and Setup

- [Standard Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-standard-terms.html) (ar: البنود القياسية): The Standard Term catalogue in Contracting: what a term is, parent and leaf terms, the accounts set on a term, the screen's actions, and where terms are used next. - entities: ContractingStandardTerm - screens (ar): بند قياسي - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Standard Term
- [Term Sheets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-term-sheets.html) (ar: كراسة الشروط): A term sheet is a bill of quantities saved as a document. - entities: TermSheet - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Term Sheet
- [Term Analysis Cards](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-term-analysis-cards.html) (ar: كارت تحليل البند): A term line says "plain concrete, 300 m³, 420 each". - entities: TermAnalysisCard - screens (ar): كارت التحليل - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Term Analysis Card
- [Contract Conditions](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-conditions.html) (ar: الشروط التعاقدية): Every construction contract carries clauses that move money without being work: retain 5% of each payment until final handover, recover the mobilisation advance at 20% of every certificate, deduct 1,000 per day of delay... - entities: ContractingCondition, ContractingConditionsGroup - screens (ar): شرط قياسي, مجموعة الشروط القياسية - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Contracting Condition
- [Contracting Price Lists](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-price-lists.html) (ar: قوائم أسعار المقاولات): How to set up Contracting Price Lists (rate cards per customer and currency), publish or withdraw them, and how priority decides which list fills the rate on a term line. - entities: ContractingPriceList - screens (ar): قائمة أسعار المقاولات - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Contracting Price list
- [Phases and Work Areas](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-phases-and-work-areas.html) (ar: المراحل ومناطق العمل): A bill of quantities answers what work is being done. - entities: ContractingPhase, ContractingPhasesGroup, ContrWorkArea - screens (ar): مرحلة مقاولة, مجموعة مراحل, منطقة عمل مقاولات
- [Contract Templates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-contract-templates.html) (ar: نماذج العقود): Contractors repeat themselves. - entities: ContractTemplate - screens (ar): نموذج عقد مقاولات - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Contract Template
- [Contractors and Consultants](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-contractors-and-consultants.html) (ar: المقاولون والاستشاريون): The Subcontractor and Consultant master files in Contracting: what each records, the subcontractor's accounts, retention and advances, and how both are attached to a project. - entities: Contractor, ContractingAdvisory, ContractorClassification - screens (ar): مقاول باطن, إستشاري, فئة مقاول باطن
- [Modify Contractor Info Request](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-modify-contractor-info-request.html) (ar: طلب تعديل بيانات المقاول (Modify Contractor Info Request)): The Modify Contractor Info Request document for updating an existing contractor or adding a new one: its fields, the two apply buttons, what is copied, the draft option on the term and its messages. - entities: ModifyContractorInfoReq - menu: Contracting → Master Files → Modify Contractor Info Request
- [Units, Tasks and Other Lookups](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/setup/contracting-lookups.html) (ar: وحدات القياس والمهام والملفات المساعدة): Reference for the small Contracting lookup files: Contracting Units of Measure, Contracting Tasks, Term Categories 1 and 2, Fine Reasons, Direct-Cost Items and Tax Extract Terms. - entities: ContractingUOM, ContractingTask, ContrTermCategory, ContrTermCategory2, ContractingFineReason, ContractingDirectCost, ContractingTaxExtractTerm - screens (ar): وحدة قياس مقاولات, مهمة مقاولات, تصنيف بند مقاولة, تصنيف بند مقاولة 2, سبب غرامة مقاولات, بند تكلفة مقاولات, بند مستخلص ضريبي

#### Contracting Document Terms

- [Contracting Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/document-terms/) (ar: توجيهات مستندات المقاولات)
- [Document Terms Basics](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/document-terms/contracting-terms-basics.html) (ar: أساسيات توجيه المستندات): A document term (توجيه المستند) is the small configuration record that tells one document type how to behave — and, above everything else in Contracting, which accounts it posts to. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Extract Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/document-terms/contracting-terms-extracts.html) (ar: توجيه المستخلصات): The extract is the only document in a contracting chain that reaches the ledger, which makes its term the most consequential piece of configuration in the module. - entities: DocumentTerm - screens (ar): توجيه مستند - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Material and Payment Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/document-terms/contracting-terms-materials.html) (ar: توجيه مستندات الخامات والدفعات): The terms on this page cover two families that look unrelated and turn out to be closely connected: the documents that move material onto a site, and the documents that move money in advance of an extract. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term
- [Other Contracting Document Terms](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/document-terms/contracting-terms-other.html) (ar: توجيه مستندات المقاولات الأخرى): Once the extracts, the material streams and the payment documents are configured, what remains is a long tail of terms that are mostly very small: one debit, one credit, and a guard or two. - entities: DocumentTerm - menu: Basic → Settings → Document Term

#### Project Contracting

- [Project Contracting](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/) (ar: مقاولة المشروع)

- [Contracting Offers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-offers.html) (ar: عرض سعر المقاولات): Every contract in this module starts as a number somebody had to justify. - entities: ContractingOffer - screens (ar): عرض سعرالمقاولات - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Contracting Offer
- [Contracting Assays](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-assays.html) (ar: مقايسة المقاولات): The document this page describes is مقايسة مقاولات — a priced bill of quantities, the classic Arabic construction term for a measured schedule of works with quantities and rates. - entities: ContractingAssay - screens (ar): مقايسة مقاولات - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Contracting Assay
- [Project Contracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-contract.html) (ar: عقد المشروع): The project contract is the centre of gravity of the whole contracting module. - entities: ProjectContract - screens (ar): عقد مشروع - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Contract
- [Project Contract Updates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-contract-updates.html) (ar: تعديل عقد المشروع): The Project Contract Update (variation order) that changes a project contract after its first extract: filling it in, actions, refreshing the snapshot and what blocks commit or delete. - entities: ProjectContractUpdate - screens (ar): تعديل عقد مشروع - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Contract Update
- [Project Execution](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-execution.html) (ar: حصر كميات المشروع): The Project Contract Execution document, a quantity-only statement of work done per period with no prices and no accounting effect: the screen, the Executions grid, back-dating, save checks and how extracts use it. - entities: ProjContractExecution - screens (ar): حصر كميات مشروع - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Contract Execution
- [Project Extracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-extracts.html) (ar: مستخلص المشروع): The Project Contract Extract, the owner-side billing document: extract types, the Details grid, the seven grids, conditions such as retention, advances and fines, the net payable and the journal it produces. - entities: ProjContrExtract - screens (ar): مستخلص مشروع - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Contract Extract
- [Taxes on Extracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-extract-taxes.html) (ar: الضرائب على المستخلصات): How project extract lines are mapped to tax extract terms for tax reporting and e-invoicing: the tax extract term master file, the Missing Tax Term Strategy switch, the Taxing Details grid and tax percentages. - entities: ProjContrExtract, ContractingTaxExtractTerm - screens (ar): مستخلص مشروع, بند مستخلص ضريبي
- [Project Advance Payments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-advances.html) (ar: الدفعات المقدمة من العميل): The Project Advance Payment document: recording the owner's advance on a contract, the recovery rule, how each extract recovers it, what the advance books and what blocks a commit. - entities: ProjectAdvancePayment - screens (ar): دفعة مشروع مقدمة - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Advance Payment
- [Project Fines](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-project-fines.html) (ar: غرامات عقد المشروع): The Project Contract Fine document: recording penalties against the owner contract, its own journal entry, its cost against the BOQ term, deduction from the next extract, and the rules that lock or block it. - entities: ProjectContractFine - screens (ar): سند غرامة عقد مشروع - menu: Contracting → Project Contracting → Project Contract Fine
- [Measurements, Submittals and Handover](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/project-contracting/contracting-measurements-and-approvals.html) (ar: طلبات الرفع والاعتمادات والتسليم): Three approval records around the contracting billing chain: Measurements Request (site visit before pricing), Customer Submittal (material approval) and Project Deliver Letter (handover); none of them books anything. - entities: MeasurementsRequest, CustomerSubmittal, ProjectDeliverLetter - screens (ar): طلب رفع مقاسات, اعتماد العميل للصنف, خطاب تسليم مشروع

#### Subcontractor Contracting

- [Subcontractor Contracting](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/) (ar: مقاولة مقاول الباطن)
- [The Subcontractor Cycle](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-cycle.html) (ar: دورة مقاول الباطن): Overview of the subcontractor chain under Contracting > Contractor Contracting (offer, contract, execution, update, extract and payment), what is optional, what books, and how it mirrors the owner-side cycle. - entities: ContractorContract, ContractorContrExtract, ContractorContractOffer, ContractorContractExecution, ContractorContractUpdate, Contractor - screens (ar): عقد مقاول باطن, مستخلص مقاول باطن, عرض سعر مقاول باطن, حصر كميات مقاول باطن, تعديل عقد مقاول باطن, مقاول باطن
- [Subcontractor Offers](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-offers.html) (ar: عرض سعر مقاول الباطن): The Contractor Contract Offer master file: recording each subcontractor's priced quote (terms, conditions and payments grids), comparing quotes, and converting the chosen offer into a subcontract. - entities: ContractorContractOffer - screens (ar): عرض سعر مقاول باطن - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Contract Offer
- [Subcontracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-contract.html) (ar: عقد مقاول الباطن): The subcontract is the centre of gravity of the cost side, exactly as the project contract is of the revenue side: the rates you have agreed to pay one firm for one package, the clauses that will reduce every certificate you issue him... - entities: ContractorContract - screens (ar): عقد مقاول باطن - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Contract
- [Subcontract Updates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-contract-updates.html) (ar: تعديل عقد مقاول الباطن): The Contractor Contract Update document, which changes a subcontract after its first certified extract: how it differs from the owner-side update, actions, a worked example and what blocks commit or delete. - entities: ContractorContractUpdate - screens (ar): تعديل عقد مقاول باطن - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Contract Update
- [Subcontractor Execution](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-execution.html) (ar: حصر كميات مقاول الباطن): A subcontractor's invoice is only as trustworthy as the measurement behind it. - entities: ContractorContractExecution - screens (ar): حصر كميات مقاول باطن - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Contract Execution
- [Subcontractor Extracts](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-extracts.html) (ar: مستخلص مقاول الباطن): Everything else on the subcontractor side is preparation. - entities: ContractorContrExtract - screens (ar): مستخلص مقاول باطن - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Contract Extract
- [Subcontractor Advances and Other Payments](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-advances-and-payments.html) (ar: دفعات مقاول الباطن): A blockwork subcontractor cannot start without buying scaffolding, hiring a gang and putting a mixer on site, and he will not have been paid a penny yet because nothing has been measured. - entities: ContractorAdvancePayment, ContractorOtherPayment - screens (ar): دفعة مقاول باطن مقدمة, دفعة مقاول باطن أخرى - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Advance Payment
- [Subcontractor Fines](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contractor-contracting/contracting-contractor-fines.html) (ar: غرامات مقاول الباطن): The Contractor Contract Fine document: recording a charge against a subcontractor, its fine lines, what it books, how it is deducted from the next extract, what can change afterwards, and fine reasons. - entities: ContractorContractFine - screens (ar): سند غرامة عقد مقاول باطن - menu: Contracting → Contractor Contracting → Contractor Contract Fine

- [Pushing Cost onto Real Estate Units](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/costs/contracting-realestate-cost-bridge.html) (ar: ترحيل التكلفة إلى الوحدات العقارية): A contractor working on somebody else's land only ever needs cost per term: what did the blockwork cost, what did the plastering cost, are we inside the rate we tendered.

#### Contracting Quality Control

- [Contracting Quality Control](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/quality/) (ar: ضبط جودة المقاولات)
- [Site Quality Control](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/quality/contracting-quality-overview.html) (ar: ضبط الجودة بالموقع): Every construction site runs on paper.
- [Inspection and Test Plans](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/quality/contracting-inspection-plans.html) (ar: خطط الفحص والاختبار): An ITP — an Inspection and Test Plan — is the document a contractor submits at the start of a job to answer one question in advance: for every activity on this project, what will be inspected, against which specification, and who has to witness it. - entities: CQCITP, CQCITPRegister
- [Activity Inspection Requests](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/quality/contracting-activity-inspections.html) (ar: طلب فحص نشاط): The Activity Inspection Request document for asking the consultant to inspect finished work before it is covered: what is inspected, the three signing panels, the two verdicts and what approval unblocks. - entities: CQCActivityInspectionReq - menu: Contracting → Quality → Activity Inspection Request
- [Material Inspection on Delivery](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/quality/contracting-material-inspection.html) (ar: فحص الخامات عند التوريد): The Material Receipt (material receiving report) and MRR Register screens for recording site deliveries and their consultant approval; a standalone form with no link to purchase orders, items or suppliers. - entities: CQCMaterialReceipt, CQCMRRRegister
- [Site Checklists and Test Reports](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/quality/contracting-site-checklists.html) (ar: قوائم فحص الموقع وتقارير الاختبار): Eight of the thirteen screens in the Quality group are specific site forms — the sheet you fill before a pour, the sheet you fill after it, the one for a buried pipe run, the one for a pressure test. - entities: FinishingWorksCheckList, DiggingBackFilingCheckList, CQCPreConcreteInspection, CQCPostConcreteInspection, CQCUndergroundPipingChecks, CQCCleaningAndFlushing, CQCHydroStaticFireSysTest, TestReport
- [Contracting FAQ](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/contracting/contracting-faq.html) (ar: أسئلة متكررة عن المقاولات): These are the questions that come up again and again on live Contracting installations.

### Project Management

- [Project Management](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/) (ar: ادارة المشاريع): Project Management (ECPA) is the Nama module for firms whose product is professional time rather than goods: architecture and engineering offices, consultancies, audit and legal practices, design studios.
- [Project Management (ECPA) Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/ecpa-overview.html) (ar: نظرة عامة على ادارة المشاريع (ECPA)): Overview of the Project Management (ECPA) module for engineering and consulting offices: its licence, how it differs from Contracting, the setup vocabulary, the quotation-to-invoice flow and the menu group by group. - licence: ecpa
- [Project Management Settings](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/ecpa-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات ادارة المشاريع): Most of what makes a project behave the way it does — its phases, its disciplines, its rates, its accounts — is set on the project itself. - entities: ConfigEntry - screens (ar): إعدادات النظام - licence: ecpa
- [Where Project Cost and Revenue Come From](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/ecpa-costing-and-profitability.html) (ar: مصادر تكلفة وإيراد المشروع): "What did this project cost us, and did we make money on it?" - entities: CPAProject, CPAProjectStage - screens (ar): مشروع إداري, مرحلة مشروع - licence: ecpa
- [Project Management Reports](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/ecpa-reports.html) (ar: تقارير ادارة المشاريع): Project Management (ECPA) ships two reports, and both of them are about the same thing: employee time. - licence: ecpa

#### Projects

- [Projects](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/) (ar: المشاريع)
- [Project Types, Classes and Disciplines](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-project-setup.html) (ar: أنواع وتصنيفات وتخصصات المشاريع): Before an engineering office can open its first project in Project Management (ECPA), it has to teach Nama its own vocabulary: what kinds of work it sells, how it likes to slice its portfolio for reporting... - entities: CPAProjectType, CPAProjectSubType, CPAProjectClass, CPADiscipline - screens (ar): نوع المشروع, نوع مشروع فرعى, تصنيف المشروع - licence: ecpa
- [Milestones and the Phase–Discipline Matrix](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-milestones-and-matrix.html) (ar: المراحل ومصفوفة المراحل والتخصصات): ECPA project milestones, the Phases Discipline Group template and the project's phase-discipline grids, and the checks applied when the project is saved. - entities: CPAProjectMileStone, CPAPhasesDisciplineGroup, CPAProject - screens (ar): مرحلة, مجموعة المراحل والتخصصات, مشروع إداري - licence: ecpa
- [The Managed Project](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-managed-project.html) (ar: المشروع الإداري): Everything in Project Management (ECPA) hangs off one record: the Managed Project. - entities: CPAProject - screens (ar): مشروع إداري - menu: Project Management → Projects → Managed Project
- [Project Sales Quotation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-sales-quotation.html) (ar: عرض أسعار المشروع): Everything else in Project Management (ECPA) assumes a project already exists. - entities: CPASalesQuotation - screens (ar): عرض أسعار مشروع - menu: Project Management → Projects → CPA Projects Sales Quotation - licence: ecpa
- [Project Templates](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-project-templates.html) (ar: قوالب المشاريع): The ECPA Template Project screen: what it holds, which values copy to a new project, and what a new project still needs after using a template. - entities: CPATemplateProject - screens (ar): قالب مشروع - menu: Project Management → Projects → Template Project
- [Project Stages](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-project-stages.html) (ar: مستندات مرحلة المشروع): Most of Project Management (ECPA) is built around people and hours. - entities: CPAProjectStage - screens (ar): مرحلة مشروع - menu: Project Management → Projects → Project Stage
- [Stage Extensions](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-stage-extensions.html) (ar: تمديد مراحل المشروع): A Project Stage holds the promise: each phase, its targeted number of days, and the dates that follow from them. - entities: CPAProjectStageExtension, CPAStageExtensionReason, CPAStageExtensionReasonType - screens (ar): تمديد مرحلة مشروع, سبب تمديد مرحلة, نوع سبب تمديد مرحلة - menu: Project Management → Projects → Project Stage Extension
- [Procedures](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/projects/ecpa-procedures.html) (ar: الاجراءات): The name invites a misunderstanding, so start here: a Procedure in Project Management (ECPA) is not a workflow definition, not a checklist template and not a stored routine. - entities: CPAProcedure - menu: Project Management → Projects → Procedure

- [Approving Worked Hours](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/ecpa/task-execution/ecpa-timesheet-approval.html) (ar: الموافقة على أوقات التنفيذ): Hours recorded on a Tasks Executing document are a claim, not a fact. - entities: CPATimeSheetApproval - screens (ar): موافقة على تنفيذ مهمة - menu: Project Management → Task Execution / Approvals → TimeSheet Approval

### Fixed Assets

- [Fixed Assets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/) (ar: الأصول الثابتة): Nama Fixed Assets is the register of everything your company owns and uses rather than sells — machines, vehicles, buildings, furniture, land.
- [Fixed Assets Module Overview](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/fixedassets-overview.html) (ar: نظرة عامة على وحدة الأصول الثابتة): Overview of the Fixed Assets module: the asset register and the documents that change it, one asset's life from purchase to sale, asset statuses, the menu folders and the four licences.
- [Module Configuration](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/fixedassets-configuration.html) (ar: إعدادات الوحدة): Most of what the Fixed Assets module does is decided document by document, on the document's term (توجيه). - menu: Assets → Settings
- [Getting Started with Fixed Assets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/fixedassets-getting-started.html) (ar: البدء والتأسيس في الأصول الثابتة): Setting up Fixed Assets in a fresh database is not hard, but the order matters more than in most modules.

#### Master Files and Setup

- [Master Files and Setup](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/) (ar: الملفات والإعدادات)
- [Fixed Asset Types](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-asset-types.html) (ar: أنواع الأصول الثابتة): The Fixed Asset Type master file: the accounts, useful life, salvage value and depreciation settings it gives each asset, what is copied when a type is chosen, overriding it on one asset, and a full setup example. - entities: FAType - screens (ar): نوع أصل - menu: Assets → Master Files → Fixed Asset Type
- [The Fixed Asset Record](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-asset-master.html) (ar: بطاقة الأصل الثابت): The Fixed Asset master file, page by page: the identity fields you type, the financial figures written only by documents, insurance and custody, statistics, maintenance history, save refusals and messages. - entities: FixedAsset - screens (ar): أصل ثابت - menu: Assets → Master Files → Fixed Asset
- [Asset Statuses](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-asset-status.html) (ar: حالات الأصل): The Status field on a fixed asset is one word, it cannot be typed, and it decides more about what you are allowed to do than any other field on the record. - entities: FixedAsset - screens (ar): أصل ثابت - menu: Assets → Master Files → Fixed Asset
- [Classifications](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-classifications.html) (ar: تصنيفات الأصول الثابتة): The five Fixed Asset Classification master files: how the five levels chain into a tree, how they land on an asset, what they are used for in lists and reports, and what they do not control. - entities: FAClassification1, FAClassification2, FAClassification3, FAClassification4, FAClassification5 - screens (ar): تصنيف أصل ثابت 1, تصنيف أصل ثابت 2, تصنيف أصل ثابت 3, تصنيف أصل ثابت 4, تصنيف أصل ثابت 5
- [Asset Locations](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-locations.html) (ar: مواقع الأصول): An asset register that cannot tell you where the machine is standing is only half a register. - entities: FALocation - screens (ar): موقع أصول - menu: Assets → Master Files → Asset Location
- [Components and Component Types](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-components.html) (ar: المكونات وأنواع المكونات): The Fixed Asset Component Type master file and the components grid on an asset: defining maintainable parts, why the grid must be filled before maintenance is recorded, and what a visit writes back. - entities: FAComponentType - screens (ar): نوع مكون أصل - menu: Assets → Master Files → Fixed Asset Component Type
- [The Fixed Asset Creation Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/master-files/fixedassets-creation-document.html) (ar: سند إنشاء أصول): The Fixed Asset Creation Document: turning a contracting project into fixed assets, its screen, the rule it enforces, the term it needs, what committing creates and why it does not set cost; needs the contracting licence. - entities: FACreationDoc - menu: Assets → Master Files → Fixed Asset Creation Document

#### Acquiring Assets

- [Acquiring Assets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/) (ar: اقتناء الأصول)
- [How an Asset Is Acquired](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-acquisition-cycle.html) (ar: كيف يُقتنى الأصل): The fixed-asset acquisition chain from purchase request to purchase invoice and receipt: which document creates the asset record and which one affects the ledger.
- [Fixed Asset Purchase Request](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-purchase-request.html) (ar: طلب شراء أصل): The purchase request is the internal ask: the paint shop needs a compressor, production needs a CNC cutting machine. - entities: FAPurchaseRequest - screens (ar): طلب  شراء أصل - menu: Assets → Documents → Fixed Asset Purchase Request
- [Offers and Purchase Orders](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-purchase-offers-and-orders.html) (ar: عروض الأسعار وأوامر الشراء): Between "we need a CNC machine" and "here is the supplier's invoice" sit the two documents where purchasing does its work: the Fixed Asset Offer (عرض سعر أصل), which records what a supplier is willing to sell for... - entities: FAPurchaseOffer, FAPurchaseOrder - screens (ar): عرض سعر أصل, أمر شراء أصل
- [The Fixed Asset Purchase Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-purchase-document.html) (ar: سند شراء أصل ثابت): Everything before this document is paperwork. - entities: FAPurchaseDocument - menu: Assets → Documents → Fixed Asset Purchase Document
- [Taking Delivery: Initial Receipt and Receipt Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-receipts.html) (ar: الاستلام: السند المبدئي ومستند الاستلام): Two documents in this module have "receipt" in their name, they sit in different menu folders, they need different licences, and they do completely different jobs. - entities: FAInitialReceipt, FAReceiptDoc - screens (ar): سند استلام أصل مبدئي, مستند أستلام أصل
- [Opening Balances for Assets You Already Own](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-opening-balances.html) (ar: الأرصدة الافتتاحية للأصول المملوكة سلفاً): Almost nobody starts using Fixed Assets on the day they buy their first machine. - entities: FAOpeningDocument, FAOpeningDocumentUpdate - screens (ar): أفتتاح أصل ثابت, تعديل أفتتاح أصل ثابت - menu: Assets → Documents → Fixed Asset Opening Document
- [Custodies Delivery Receipt Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/acquisition/fixedassets-delivery-receipt.html) (ar: سند استلام وتسليم عهد): The Custodies Delivery Receipt Document: handing custody items and fixed assets from one employee to another, what committing it does and what it books. - entities: FADeliveryReceiptDoc - menu: Assets → Custody Of Assets → Custodies Delivery Receipt Document

#### Letters of Credit

- [Letters of Credit](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/letters-of-credit/) (ar: إعتمادات الأصول)
- [Importing Assets on a Letter of Credit](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/letters-of-credit/fixedassets-lc-overview.html) (ar: استيراد الأصول باعتماد مستندي): Overview of importing fixed assets on a letter of credit: the four documents in order (credit, proforma invoice, expense, cost), how costs are spread across assets, and the fixedassets-lc licence.
- [The Letter of Credit](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/letters-of-credit/fixedassets-letter-of-credit.html) (ar: اعتماد الأصول): The Fixed Asset Letter of Credit master file: opening a credit for an import, its parties and fields, the related documents page with the running cost breakdown, and what closes the credit. - entities: FALetterOfCredit - screens (ar): اعتماد أصول - menu: Assets → Fixed Asset Letter of Credits → Fixed asset Letter of Credit
- [The Proforma Invoice](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/letters-of-credit/fixedassets-lc-proforma-invoice.html) (ar: الفاتورة المبدئية): The Fixed Asset ProformaInvoice is the shortest document in the chain and the most misunderstood. - entities: FALCProformaInvoice - screens (ar): فاتوره اعتماد مبدئية - menu: Assets → Fixed Asset Letter of Credits → Fixed Asset ProformaInvoice
- [Expenses and Distribution](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/letters-of-credit/fixedassets-lc-expenses.html) (ar: مصروفات الاعتماد وتوزيعها): The Fixed Asset Expense Document and the Expense Item master file: entering import costs on a letter of credit and distributing each line across the assets by value, weight or hand, with its entries and messages. - entities: FALcExpenseDocument, AdditionalCost - screens (ar): مصروف اعتماد أصل, بند مصروف - menu: Assets → Fixed Asset Letter of Credits → Fixed Asset Expense Document
- [The Cost Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/letters-of-credit/fixedassets-lc-cost-document.html) (ar: سند تكليف الاعتماد): Up to this point the import has cost 615,000 and nobody owns a press. - entities: FALCCostDoc - screens (ar): سند تكليف اعتماد أصل - menu: Assets → Fixed Asset Letter of Credits → Fixed Asset Letter of Credit cost

#### Depreciation and Value Changes

- [Depreciation and Value Changes](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/) (ar: الإهلاك وتعديل القيمة)
- [How Depreciation Works](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-depreciation-concepts.html) (ar: كيف يحسب النظام الإهلاك): Everything the Fixed Assets module does with depreciation comes out of a single line of arithmetic applied once per fiscal period.
- [The Depreciation Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-depreciation-document.html) (ar: سند الإهلاك): The depreciation document is the period-end run: one document per fiscal period, holding one line per asset, each line carrying that asset's charge for the period. - entities: FADepreciation - screens (ar): سند إهلاك - menu: Assets → Documents → Depreciation Document
- [The Aggregated Depreciation Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-aggregated-depreciation.html) (ar: سند الإهلاك المجمع): The Aggregated Depreciation Document: running depreciation over a range of fiscal periods at once, which creates and commits one depreciation document per period, used for catch-up at go-live. - entities: AggrFADepreciation - screens (ar): سند إهلاك مجمع - menu: Assets → Documents → Aggregated Depreciation Document
- [Freezing an Asset's Depreciation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-prevent-depreciation.html) (ar: تجميد إهلاك أصل): Sometimes an asset should not be depreciated for a while. - entities: FAPreventAssetsDeprec - screens (ar): مستند منع اهلاك اصول - menu: Assets → Documents → Prevent Assets Depreciation Document
- [Revaluation](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-revaluation.html) (ar: إعادة تقييم الأصول): Fixed asset revaluation: setting an asset to the Revaluation depreciation method, the Fixed Asset Revaluation document, the gain or loss entries it books, where its accounts come from, and cancelling it. - entities: FARevaluation - menu: Assets → Documents → Fixed Asset Revaluation
- [Additions and Deductions](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-additions-and-deductions.html) (ar: الإضافة والإستبعاد): The Asset Addition Deduction document: capitalising an improvement or writing off value on one asset's cost, the instalment arithmetic, changing remaining life, the aggregated version and its messages. - entities: FAAdditionDeduction, AggrAdditionDeduction - screens (ar): سند الإضافة و الإستبعاد, مستند إضافة واستبعاد مجمع - menu: Assets → Documents → Asset addition deduction
- [Re-estimating an Asset's Life and Salvage Value](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/depreciation/fixedassets-properties-document.html) (ar: إعادة تقدير عمر الأصل وقيمة خردته): Useful life and salvage value are estimates, and estimates get revised. - entities: FAPropertiesDocument, AggrFAPropertiesDocument - screens (ar): خصائص أصل ثابت, سند خصائص أصل مجمع - menu: Assets → Documents → Fixed Asset Properties

#### Transfers and Stocktaking

- [Transfers and Stocktaking](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/movement/) (ar: نقل الأصول والجرد)
- [Moving an Asset: The Transfer Document](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/movement/fixedassets-transfer-document.html) (ar: نقل الأصل: سند نقل الأصل): The fixed asset Transfer document: moving an asset between locations, dimensions, accounts or companies, the entries each kind of move produces, what blocks a commit, cancelling, and aggregated transfers. - entities: FATransferDocument, AggrFATransferDoc - screens (ar): سند نقل أصل مجمع - menu: Assets → Custody Of Assets → Transfer document
- [Asking for a Move: The Transfer Request](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/movement/fixedassets-transfer-requests.html) (ar: طلب النقل: كيف يُطلب تحريك الأصل): In most plants the person who decides that a machine should move is not the person who is allowed to change the asset register. - entities: FATransferRequest, AggFATransferRequest - screens (ar): طلب نقل أصل, طلب نقل أصل مجمع - menu: Assets → Custody Of Assets → Fixed Asset Transfer Request
- [Transfers Between Companies](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/movement/fixedassets-intercompany-transfers.html) (ar: النقل بين الشركات): Moving a machine between two branches of one company is bookkeeping housekeeping: the same balances sit under a different label. - entities: FATransferDocument - screens (ar): سند نقل الأصل - menu: Assets → Custody Of Assets → Transfer document
- [Sending Assets Out and Bringing Them Back](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/movement/fixedassets-movement-in-out.html) (ar: خروج الأصول من المنشأة ورجوعها): The Fixed Asset Out Document and Fixed Asset Return Document: recording units of a countable asset leaving the premises and coming back, how the outside count is checked, and reading the counters. - entities: FAMovementOutDoc, FAMovementInDoc - screens (ar): سند خروج أصول, سند رجوع أصول
- [Stocktaking Fixed Assets](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/movement/fixedassets-stocktaking.html) (ar: جرد الأصول الثابتة): The FixedAssets Taking Document: counting fixed assets and custody items by location or by employee, building the count sheet, how missing and unexpected items are listed, and acting on the findings. - entities: FAFixedAssetsTaking - screens (ar): مستند جرد أصول - menu: Assets → Custody Of Assets → FixedAssets Taking Document

#### Disposal

- [Disposal](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/disposal/) (ar: التخلص من الأصول)
- [Disposing of an Asset](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/disposal/fixedassets-disposal.html) (ar: التخلص من الأصل): The Fixed Assets Disposal Document: selling, scrapping or writing off a whole asset, the depreciation-first rule, the gain or loss arithmetic and entries, electronic sale invoices, undoing a disposal and its messages. - entities: FADisposalDocument - menu: Assets → Documents → Fixed assets disposal document
- [Partial Disposal](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/disposal/fixedassets-partial-disposal.html) (ar: التخلص الجزئي من أصل): The Fixed Asset Partial Disposal Document: disposing of some units of a countable asset, the cost and depreciation split, the effect on the depreciation schedule, salvaged assets and undoing it. - entities: FAPartialDisposalDoc - screens (ar): سند تخلص جزئي من أصل - menu: Assets → Documents → Fixed Asset Partial Disposal Document
- [Disposing of Many Assets at Once](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/disposal/fixedassets-aggregated-disposal.html) (ar: التخلص من عدة أصول دفعة واحدة): The Aggregated Fixed Asset Disposal Document: disposing of many assets in one grid, which generates one ordinary disposal document per line, what blocks a commit and where to check the result. - entities: AggrFADisposalDoc - screens (ar): سند تخلص مجمع - menu: Assets → Documents → Aggregated Fixed Asset Disposal Document

#### Custodies

- [Custodies](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/custody/) (ar: العهد)
- [Custody — Items Handed to Staff](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/custody/fixedassets-custody-overview.html) (ar: العهد — الأشياء التي تسلّمها لموظفيك): Overview of the Custody register for items handed to staff: how it differs from fixed assets, its six screens and licence, the status ladder and undo order.
- [Custody Types](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/custody/fixedassets-custody-types.html) (ar: أنواع العهد): The Custody Type master file in Fixed Assets: its fields, what the Priceless flag changes on custody records and documents, and what a custody type does not control. - entities: CustodyType - screens (ar): نوع العهدة - menu: Assets → Custodys → Custody Type
- [The Custody Record](https://docs.namasoft.com/modules/fixedassets/custody/fixedassets-custody-register.html) (ar: سجل العهدة): The custody record is the register itself — one record for one physical item that Al-Waha Industries has handed out, or is about to. - entities: FACustody - menu: Assets → Custodys → Custody
